remarks.defaultText: This method is an applicant self-service action and writes no reviewer fields. Ownership and status conditions live in the same UPDATE statement (`ApplicantUserId` and `ApplicationStatus = Returned`), so there is no read-then-write window. Because a table check constraint requires the review time and reviewer to be null in thestate, the statement must clear both or the constraint rejects the change; the review comment column is retained while the authoritative history lives in transition events. Submitted

remarks.defaultText: The caller must first provide a controlled desktop entry, cache identity, Portal, and module configuration. On a cache hit this method does not construct child controls; on a miss it loads only that entry and performs interface/configuration injection. A load failure records diagnostics and leaves an empty module region so one module cannot block the portal page; it does not rewrite module definitions, package state, cache keys, or expiry policy.

localizedText.zh-CN: 调用方应先提供受控桌面入口、缓存身份、Portal 和模块配置。命中缓存时本方法不构造子控件；未命中时仅加载该入口并执行接口/配置注入。加载失败会记录诊断并留下空模块区域，避免单个模块阻断门户页；它不改写模块定义、包状态、缓存键或过期策略。
localizedText.en: The caller must first provide a controlled desktop entry, cache identity, Portal, and module configuration. When `rolesDb` is unavailable the permission key set is **empty**, which grants nothing (the administrator flag still depends on a role name or an explicit permission key and is never elevated by a missing dependency). Ordinary static checks cannot prove that constraint, so it is registered here explicitly: callers must never treat "authorization unavailable" as "authorized". false

remarks.defaultText: Before tab names were localized this line was simply `boundTab.TabName`; afterwards it must go through the resolver, or an English UI would show Chinese tab names. The query reads only the two identifier columns needed for expansion, and the expansion itself runs through thepure function so this semantics stays unit testable without a database; the depth cap and the visited set together keep a malformed cycle from recursing forever. Failures always yield an empty set rather than degrading to a full scan.

localizedText.zh-CN: W68 新增。取数只读取展开所需的两个标识列，展开由纯函数完成，因此这部分语义可在无数据库环境中被单测覆盖；深度上限与"已访问"集合共同保证即使出现环路也不会无限递归。失败一律返回空集合，不退化为全量。

remarks.defaultText: The generic error page displays only event ids matching the runtime format. Detailed errors are retained only for explicitly configured local requests; exception bodies, connection strings, and other runtime details must not be returned directly to ordinary visitors. The exception first enters the diagnostic-sanitization path; the handler then decides whether to retain ASP.NET details based on the generic-error target, the explicit detailed-error switch, and local-request status. Redirects carry only a controlled event id and never write the exception object or connection string to the response.

remarks.defaultText: Web Forms usually lets ASP.NET create pages and controls before project code runs, so constructor injection is unavailable in legacy pages. This method limits Unityto the compatibility role of filling registered property dependencies; it does not create controls or change their lifecycle. BuildUp This compatibility entry assumes the container was created during startup and leaves exception and lifecycle responsibility with the existing Unity/Web Forms caller; it does not create controls, perform authorization, or hide unregistered-dependency errors.

remarks.defaultText: Added in W71. This is an applicant self-service action kept apart from the review responsibility of: only the original applicant may resubmit, and only fromto. Both the ownership and status conditions live in a single UPDATE statement to prevent state drift between reading and writing (TOCTOU). An implementation must also clear the review time and reviewer columns because a table check constraint requires both to be null in thestate. The contract is fail-closed: a non-positive identifier, a missing application, an ownership mismatch, a disallowed status, or a read failure all return a failure without changing any row. Returned Submitted Submitted

localizedText.zh-CN: W71 新增。这是**申请人自助动作**，与的审核职责分开：只有提交人本人可重提，且只从重提到；归属与状态条件都写在同一个 UPDATE 语句里，避免读取与写入之间的状态漂移（TOCTOU）。实现还必须同时清空审核时间与审核人，因为表的检查约束要求状态下这两列为空。契约按 fail-closed 处理：标识非正值、申请不存在、归属不符、状态不允许或读取失败，一律返回失败且不改变任何行。 Returned Submitted Submitted

Items that are unauthorized or missing appear as empty lists so callers never distinguish internal states. The returned dictionary **contains every requested identifier** (empty list when no events exist) and preserves the per-item ordering of the single-item read. Empty input, unavailable schema, or read failure yields all-empty lists. CanParticipate CanView

remarks.defaultText: Added in W68: existing directory queries filter only by keyword and status and cannot express "one organization and its descendants". This method supplies the subtree identifiers for organization-scoped filtering and for the later W63 visibility extension. The contract is fail-closed: a non-positive, missing, or unreadable root, as well as schema or read failures, all yield an empty set instead of a full scan. Callers must still authorize; the identifier set itself grants no access.

localizedText.zh-CN: W68 新增：既有目录查询只能按关键字与状态过滤，无法表达"某组织及其后代"。本方法提供子树标识，供组织范围过滤与后续可见性扩展复用。契约按 fail-closed 处理：根节点非正值、不存在、架构不可用或读取失败一律返回空集合，不退化为全量；调用方仍须自行完成授权，标识集合本身不授予任何访问权。 W63

remarks.defaultText: Added in W69. Because the request table constrains status values, withdrawal reuses, records the requester as the actor, and leaves a note; no new status and no migration are needed. The contract is fail-closed: a non-positive user or request identifier, a missing request, an ownership mismatch, a status that is no longer pending, and any runtime failure all return a failure without changing any row. Failure explanations stay low-sensitivity and never echo another user's request details. Closed

localizedText.zh-CN: W69 新增。请求表状态受检查约束限定，因此撤回复用并把提交人记为操作人、在备注留痕，不引入新状态也不需要迁移。契约按 fail-closed 处理：用户标识或请求标识非正值、请求不存在、归属不符、状态已不是处理中，以及任何运行失败，都返回失败且不改变任何行；失败说明保持低敏，不回显他人请求细节。 Closed

remarks.defaultText: A row matches when the assigned user identifier equals the current user, or when the assigned role key falls inside the supplied controlled key set. This contract does not resolve role membership: the caller must resolve the key set with existing authorization capability and pass it in, so the data layer never infers ownership beyond its authority. When the supplied user identifier is non-positive and the key set is empty, the method fails closed and returns a successful but empty result instead of degrading to an unrestricted query. The result explicitly separates "succeeded with no matches" from "read failure" so a front end can render empty and failure states separately.

remarks.defaultText: P77.3 supersedes the original T3 verdict (2026-09-29: every kind is unreachable in the front end, so always return an empty string). That verdict saw only that no statically resolvable front-end deep link exists and **missed the runtime reverse lookup**: the tab owning a module instance is already registered in the database, so the chain from business kind to capability key to primary module package to validated desktop entry to module definition to module instance to hosting tab can be walked, and the current request's role check then confirms reachability (see). A full pass yields a URL while any failed link degrades to the hint. The Admin mapping onand this ordinary-user reachability decision do not substitute for each other. Admin/WorkItems.aspx

localizedText.zh-CN: P77.3 取代原 T3 判定（2026-09-29 的「三类业务在前台恒不可达、故恒返回空串」）。原判定只看到「没有可静态解析的前台深链」，**漏掉了运行期反查**：模块实例归属的页签本就登记在库中，可按「业务类型 → 能力键 → 主责模块包 → 已验证桌面入口 → 模块定义 → 模块实例 → 承载页签」逐环反查，再用当次请求的角色检查确认可达性（见）。命中即产出地址，任一环落空即降级为提示；后台的 Admin 映射与这里的普通用户可达性判定互不替代。 Admin/WorkItems.aspx

Decides whether a Tab is the protected core administration Tab by its **navigation stable key** (preferred) or display name (fallback).

remarks.defaultText: Why a stable key is required: tab names (`TabName`) are now multilingual, so the display name changes with the UI culture and can even be renamed to Chinese by an administrator, while "administration entry protection", "rename blocked", and "keep the administration Tab last" all recognize by name. If recognition stayed on the display name, the moment `Admin` became "后台管理" the protection would silently stop working — the most dangerous knock-on effect of localizing tab names. Migration `PortalCfg_TabModuleMultilingualNames.sql` backfills existing tab names as stable keys, so existing deployments regress not at all.

localizedText.zh-CN: 为什么必须引入稳定键：页签名（`TabName`）已支持多语言，显示名会随界面文化改变甚至被管理员改成中文， 而"后台入口保护""禁止重命名""后台 Tab 排到最后"这些策略都按名识别。若继续按显示名判定， 把 Admin 改成"后台管理"的那一刻，保护就会静默失效 —— 这正是页签名本地化最危险的连带破坏点。 迁移脚本 `PortalCfg_TabModuleMultilingualNames.sql` 已把既有页签名回填为稳定键，因此存量部署零回归。
localizedText.en: Why a stable key is required: tab names (`TabName`) are now multilingual, so the display name changes with the UI culture and can even be renamed to Chinese by an administrator, while "administration entry protection", "rename blocked", and "keep the administration Tab last" all recognize by name. If recognition stayed on the display name, the moment `Admin` became "后台管理" the protection would silently stop working — the most dangerous knock-on effect of localizing tab names. Migration `PortalCfg_TabModuleMultilingualNames.sql` backfills existing tab names as stable keys, so existing deployments regress not at all.

Why a stable key is required: tab names (`TabName`) are now multilingual, so the display name changes with the UI culture and can even be renamed to Chinese by an administrator, while "administration entry protection", "rename blocked", and "keep the administration Tab last" all recognize by name. If recognition stayed on the display name, the moment `Admin` became "后台管理" the protection would silently stop working — the most dangerous knock-on effect of localizing tab names. Migration `PortalCfg_TabModuleMultilingualNames.sql` backfills existing tab names as stable keys, so existing deployments regress not at all.

entries.summary: Pure revoke decision shared by Application_AuthenticateRequest and regression tests. summary.defaultText: Pure revoke decision shared by Application_AuthenticateRequest and regression tests. remarks.defaultText: A parse failure always becomes "no hit plus a reason" and never throws: the JSON column is hand-edited by administrators, so arrays, nesting, or mistyped keys can occur, and all of them should degrade to the default language rather than turning the portal header into an error page. Key comparison is case-insensitive: casing differences in culture names (`ja-jp` versus `ja-JP`) must not lose the value.

This exit replaces hardcoded redirects to `~/Admin/AccessDenied.aspx`.

Builds the stable entry key of a main-navigation Tab; the **navigation stable key takes precedence**, falling back to the Tab display name when absent.

remarks.defaultText: Why a stable key is needed: once tab names are localized, the same tab displays differently per UI culture (`首页` / `Home`), and an administrator can rename it to anything. If the key were still derived from the display name, the registered `Tab.Home` would fail to match under the Chinese UI and the gate would silently degrade to "unregistered means allowed" — which is not a safe allow but the **vanishing of a permission check**. The migration backfills existing tab names as stable keys, so existing deployments keep their `Tab.*` keys byte-identical.

localizedText.zh-CN: 为什么需要稳定键：页签名本地化后，同一页签在不同界面文化下显示名不同（`首页` / `Home`）， 管理员还可以把它改成任意文本。若键仍由显示名派生，registry 里登记的 `Tab.Home` 会在中文界面下失配， 门控静默退化为"未登记即放行" —— 那不是安全的放行，而是**权限检查凭空消失**。 迁移脚本已把存量页签名回填为稳定键，因此存量部署的 `Tab.*` 键逐字节不变。
localizedText.en: Why a stable key is needed: once tab names are localized, the same tab displays differently per UI culture (`首页` / `Home`), and an administrator can rename it to anything. If the key were still derived from the display name, the registered `Tab.Home` would fail to match under the Chinese UI and the gate would silently degrade to "unregistered means allowed" — which is not a safe allow but the **vanishing of a permission check**. The migration backfills existing tab names as stable keys, so existing deployments keep their `Tab.*` keys byte-identical.

blocks.text: 为什么需要稳定键：页签名本地化后，同一页签在不同界面文化下显示名不同（`首页` / `Home`）， 管理员还可以把它改成任意文本。若键仍由显示名派生，registry 里登记的 `Tab.Home` 会在中文界面下失配， 门控静默退化为"未登记即放行" —— 那不是安全的放行，而是**权限检查凭空消失**。 迁移脚本已把存量页签名回填为稳定键，因此存量部署的 `Tab.*` 键逐字节不变。

Why a stable key is needed: once tab names are localized, the same tab displays differently per UI culture (`首页` / `Home`), and an administrator can rename it to anything. If the key were still derived from the display name, the registered `Tab.Home` would fail to match under the Chinese UI and the gate would silently degrade to "unregistered means allowed" — which is not a safe allow but the **vanishing of a permission check**. The migration backfills existing tab names as stable keys, so existing deployments keep their `Tab.*` keys byte-identical.

remarks.defaultText: This method deliberately fails in the opposite direction from the action area: an unregistered tab, a blank name, or a missing context is always allowed. The main navigation has already been filtered by role before this call, so allowing cannot leak an over-permissioned entry, whereas losing every tab to a gate fault would turn a governance improvement into an availability incident. The blocking decision itself still reuses the shared six-step visibility evaluation rather than defining new rules.

localizedText.zh-CN: 本方法刻意采用与动作区相反的失败方向：未登记 Tab、空白名或上下文缺失一律**放行**。原因是主导航在调用本方法前已按角色过滤，放行不会泄露超权入口；反之若 gate 故障导致全部 Tab 消失，会把"治理增强"变成可用性事故。阻断判定本身仍复用统一的六步可见性判定，不另立规则。

remarks.defaultText: A row matches when the assigned user identifier equals the supplied user, or when the assigned role key falls inside the supplied controlled key set. This method does not resolve role membership; the caller resolves the key set with existing authorization capability. When the user identifier is non-positive and the key set is empty, the method fails closed with a successful but empty result instead of degrading to an unrestricted query. The result explicitly separates "succeeded with no matches" from "read failure".

remarks.defaultText: `"system"` is a **fallback literal for a missing identity**, not a real identity: it only means "this creation recorded no specific actor", and audits or troubleshooting must not read it as automatic system execution. The fallback **does not replace the caller's duty to pass identity** — when a traceable creator is required the caller must pass it explicitly, otherwise the audit chain breaks on that record.

localizedText.zh-CN: `"system"` 是**身份缺失时的兜底字面量**，不是真实身份：它只表示"本次创建未记录到具体操作者"， 审计与排查不得据此判定为系统自动执行。该兜底**不替代调用方传递身份的责任** —— 需要可追溯的创建者时调用方必须显式传入，否则审计链在该记录上断掉。

remarks.defaultText: The method returns only outcome, reset-required, and security-version facts, not failure details. The identifier is normalized and resolved with ambiguity handling first. Missing or unreadable profile/review extension tables follow the compatibility allow path; available strong-credential tables are preferred, and an existing credential forbids fallback to the legacy password column. Legacy compatibility upgrade is allowed only when that user has no strong credential. Callers remain responsible for throttling, session/Cookie issuance, and page authorization.

localizedText.zh-CN: 方法只返回成功、失败、需重置和安全版本等结果事实，不返回失败原因细节。标识会先归一化并通过解析器处理歧义；profile/注册审核扩展表缺失或读取异常按兼容策略放行，强凭据表可用时优先使用强哈希，存在凭据时禁止回退旧密码列；仅在无该用户强凭据时才允许一次 legacy 兼容升级。调用方仍须负责登录节流、会话/Cookie 和页面授权。
localizedText.en: The method returns only outcome, reset-required, and security-version facts, not failure details. The identifier is normalized and resolved with ambiguity handling first. Missing or unreadable profile/review extension tables follow the compatibility allow path; available strong-credential tables are preferred, and an existing credential forbids fallback to the legacy password column. Legacy compatibility upgrade is allowed only when that user has no strong credential. Callers remain responsible for throttling, session/Cookie issuance, and page authorization.

blocks.text: 方法只返回成功、失败、需重置和安全版本等结果事实，不返回失败原因细节。标识会先归一化并通过解析器处理歧义；profile/注册审核扩展表缺失或读取异常按兼容策略放行，强凭据表可用时优先使用强哈希，存在凭据时禁止回退旧密码列；仅在无该用户强凭据时才允许一次 legacy 兼容升级。调用方仍须负责登录节流、会话/Cookie 和页面授权。

The method returns only outcome, reset-required, and security-version facts, not failure details. The identifier is normalized and resolved with ambiguity handling first. Missing or unreadable profile/review extension tables follow the compatibility allow path; available strong-credential tables are preferred, and an existing credential forbids fallback to the legacy password column. Legacy compatibility upgrade is allowed only when that user has no strong credential. Callers remain responsible for throttling, session/Cookie issuance, and page authorization.

remarks.defaultText: Added in W68: when enabled, descendant members are expanded recursively by the data layer (per the Microsoft Learn hierarchy-modeling guidance: subtree queries over an adjacency list need a recursive CTE or hierarchy index), guarded by an implementation-side depth cap; when disabled, only the unit itself matches.

remarks.defaultText: The caller must bind module configuration, Portal, controlled desktop entry, and cache identity before lifecycle use. A positive cache duration reuses inner output, whilecan isolate trusted-package version and state revision; the key distinguishes only the module instance and current edit-role check, not individual users. This container neither enforces Tab/module authorization nor encodes module-generated HTML, so modules must not place user-private sensitive content in shared cached output.

localizedText.zh-CN: 调用方必须在生命周期使用前绑定模块配置、Portal、受控桌面入口和缓存身份。正缓存时间会复用内部输出，受信任包版本与状态修订可由隔离；缓存键只区分模块实例和当前编辑角色判断，不按具体用户隔离。该容器不实施 Tab/模块授权，也不编码模块生成的 HTML，因此模块不得把仅对单一用户可见的敏感内容放入共享缓存输出。

remarks.defaultText: The page has exactly three responsibilities: enforce the `EnterpriseCapability.View` gate, read definitions and role mappings from read-only sources, and hand the matrix to the renderer. It writes no database row, changes no configuration, offers no granting entry point, and degrades to a hint message (instead of throwing) when the mapping table is missing.

localizedText.zh-CN: 页面职责只有三件：按 `EnterpriseCapability.View` 做权限门禁、从只读数据源取"权限定义 + 角色映射"、把矩阵交给渲染器输出。它**不写数据库、不改配置、不提供赋权入口**，映射表缺失时降级为提示文案而不抛异常。
localizedText.en: The page has exactly three responsibilities: enforce the `EnterpriseCapability.View` gate, read definitions and role mappings from read-only sources, and hand the matrix to the renderer. It writes no database row, changes no configuration, offers no granting entry point, and degrades to a hint message (instead of throwing) when the mapping table is missing.

remarks.defaultText: This policy touches no database and depends on no session or permission; it only judges field names and maps values, so unit tests can cover it completely. Design points: (1) field names must be re-validated server-side and caller-supplied values are not trusted; (2) only low-sensitivity fields that map directly ontomay be applied automatically; (3) fields that need extra resolution and could cause a wrong assignment must be explicitly marked as requiring manual handling, so approval never silently fails to take effect.

localizedText.zh-CN: 本策略不访问数据库、不依赖会话或权限，只做字段名与值的判定与映射，因此可被单测完整覆盖。设计要点：① 字段名必须由服务端二次校验，不信任调用方传入值；② 只有能直接映射到的低敏字段才允许自动回写；③ 需要另行解析且可能造成错误指派的字段必须显式标记为"需人工处理"，避免"审核通过但未生效"的静默失败。
localizedText.en: This policy touches no database and depends on no session or permission; it only judges field names and maps values, so unit tests can cover it completely. remarks.defaultText: This class initializes Unity, external connection strings, and runtime services, and handles request context, authenticated roles, and unhandled errors. Startup may probe connection availability; request processing may revoke stale tickets and rebuild the role cookie. This is not a business-authorization or configuration-write API, so new global behavior must consider startup failure, error disclosure, identity revocation, and compatibility across every request.

remarks.defaultText: This module is deliberately **purely static**: it reads no database, no system setting, performs no authorization decision, and accepts no request parameter, so it can be rendered safely to anonymous visitors. Its content is fixed in the control markup with **no administration editing surface** — that is the ADR 0027 boundary: administrator-editable HTML fragments must not be exposed to anonymous visitors before a sanitization decision exists, so help content ships with the code and removes that XSS surface entirely. Visibility is still governed by the tab's `AccessRoles`; this control never participates in authorization.

localizedText.zh-CN: 本模块刻意做成**纯静态**：不读取数据库、不读取任何系统设置、不判定授权、不接受请求参数， 因此可以安全地对匿名访客渲染。内容固化在控件标记里，**不提供后台编辑入口**——这是 ADR 0027 的边界： 后台可编辑的 HTML 片段在净化方案落地前不得公开给匿名访客；帮助内容改为随代码发布，从根上消除该 XSS 面。 可见性仍由页签的 `AccessRoles` 决定，本控件不参与授权判断。

Visibility is still governed by the tab's `AccessRoles`; this control never participates in authorization.

remarks.defaultText: Shared by the front-end workbench and the Admin collaboration page starting with P74.4. Both sites previously interpolated `` verbatim (for example `Zhang (Collaborator)`), exposing an internal identifier to end users, and fell back to a hard-coded English `(none)` for empty sets and blank fields. This type centralizes three things: (1) a known role key becomes a localized role name (the vocabulary comes from); (2) an **unknown role key falls back to the raw key** rather than inventing a translation, matching established practice elsewhere; (3) an empty set or blank field becomes the localized placeholder. The role vocabulary is a **domain fact** rather than one page's private wording, so role names and the placeholder use shared `Collaboration_*` / `Common_*` keys instead of per-page copies. Output is **not encoded here**; the markup's encoded binding (`<%#: %>`) owns that, which avoids double encoding. ParticipantRoleKey

entries.name: PortalDisplayNameResolver
entries.summary: Resolves database-carried display names (Chinese column / English column / other-languages JSON column) by UI culture.

summary.defaultText: Resolves database-carried display names (Chinese column / English column / other-languages JSON column) by UI culture.

localizedText.zh-CN: 按界面文化解析数据库承载的显示名（中文列 / 英文列 / 其它语言 JSON 列）。
localizedText.en: Resolves database-carried display names (Chinese column / English column / other-languages JSON column) by UI culture.

blocks.text: 按界面文化解析数据库承载的显示名（中文列 / 英文列 / 其它语言 JSON 列）。
Resolves database-carried display names (Chinese column / English column / other-languages JSON column) by UI culture.

remarks.defaultText: Reason it exists: the portal shell and module body text come from `App_GlobalResources/lang.*` resources, while tab names (`PortalCfg_Tabs.TabName`) and module titles (`PortalCfg_Modules.ModuleTitle`) are single-column database text that **does not follow the language switch**, producing "English title + Chinese body" inside one card. This resolver connects those texts to the same culture decision the resources use, which is what makes the mixing fixable. Column design (user decision, 2026-10-18): one Chinese column, one English column, and one JSON column for every other language. The Chinese side reuses the existing columns (`TabName` / `ModuleTitle`) rather than adding new ones — those columns are `NOT NULL` and are the default source of every renderer, so reusing them guarantees there is always something to display. Resolution order: 1. two-letter language code `zh` (including zh-CN / zh-TW and other regional variants) → Chinese column, falling back to the English column when missing; 2. two-letter code `en` → English column, falling back to the Chinese column when missing; 3. any other culture → three-tier JSON lookup "full culture name → parent culture name → two-letter code"; 4. no hit → Chinese column → English column → empty string. That fallback chain matches the existing `PortalNavigationEntry.GetDisplayName` semantics (Chinese cultures take the Chinese name, English cultures the English one, and a missing side falls back to the other), so two display-name resolvers cannot disagree about the same culture. Proof boundary: this type proves only that "the most suitable display text was selected for the culture". It does **not** prove the text is a correct translation, that JSON keys are supported cultures (that allowlist belongs to language administration), and it makes no authorization decision.

localizedText.zh-CN: 存在理由：门户壳层与模块正文走 `App_GlobalResources/lang.*` 资源，而页签名（`PortalCfg_Tabs.TabName`）与 模块标题（`PortalCfg_Modules.ModuleTitle`）是数据库单列文本，**不随语言切换**，于是同一张卡片里出现 "英文标题 + 中文正文"的中英混排。本解析器把这两类文本接入与资源同源的文化判定，混排才有解。 列设计（用户 2026-10-18 裁定）：中文一列、英文一列、其它所有语言合并为一个 JSON 列。 中文列复用既有列（`TabName` / `ModuleTitle`）而不是新增列 —— 既有列 `NOT NULL` 且是所有渲染点的默认来源， 复用它才能保证"永远有值可显示"。 解析顺序： 1. 两字母语言码 `zh`（含 zh-CN / zh-TW 等区域变体）→ 中文列，缺失回落英文列； 2. 两字母语言码 `en` → 英文列，缺失回落中文列； 3. 其它文化 → JSON 列按"完整文化名 → 父文化名 → 两字母码"三级匹配； 4. 三级都未命中 → 回落中文列 → 回落英文列 → 空字符串。 该回退链与既有 `PortalNavigationEntry.GetDisplayName` 的语义一致（中文文化取中文、英文文化取英文、 一侧缺失回落另一侧），避免两套显示名解析逻辑对同一文化给出不同结论。 证明边界：本类型只证明"按文化选出最合适的显示文本"，**不证明**文本本身翻译正确、 JSON 键是受支持的文化（键名白名单属于语言管理功能），也不做任何授权判断。

This resolver connects those texts to the same culture decision the resources use, which is what makes the mixing fixable. Column design (user decision, 2026-10-18): one Chinese column, one English column, and one JSON column for every other language. The Chinese side reuses the existing columns (`TabName` / `ModuleTitle`) rather than adding new ones — those columns are `NOT NULL` and are the default source of every renderer, so reusing them guarantees there is always something to display. Resolution order: 1. two-letter language code `zh` (including zh-CN / zh-TW and other regional variants) → Chinese column, falling back to the English column when missing; 2. two-letter code `en` → English column, falling back to the Chinese column when missing; 3. any other culture → three-tier JSON lookup "full culture name → parent culture name → two-letter code"; 4. no hit → Chinese column → English column → empty string. That fallback chain matches the existing `PortalNavigationEntry.GetDisplayName` semantics (Chinese cultures take the Chinese name, English cultures the English one, and a missing side falls back to the other), so two display-name resolvers cannot disagree about the same culture. Proof boundary: this type proves only that "the most suitable display text was selected for the culture". It does **not** prove the text is a correct translation, that JSON keys are supported cultures (that allowlist belongs to language administration), and it makes no authorization decision.

blocks.text: 存在理由：门户壳层与模块正文走 `App_GlobalResources/lang.*` 资源，而页签名（`PortalCfg_Tabs.TabName`）与 模块标题（`PortalCfg_Modules.ModuleTitle`）是数据库单列文本，**不随语言切换**，于是同一张卡片里出现 "英文标题 + 中文正文"的中英混排。本解析器把这两类文本接入与资源同源的文化判定，混排才有解。 列设计（用户 2026-10-18 裁定）：中文一列、英文一列、其它所有语言合并为一个 JSON 列。 中文列复用既有列（`TabName` / `ModuleTitle`）而不是新增列 —— 既有列 `NOT NULL` 且是所有渲染点的默认来源， 复用它才能保证"永远有值可显示"。 解析顺序： 1. 两字母语言码 `zh`（含 zh-CN / zh-TW 等区域变体）→ 中文列，缺失回落英文列； 2. 两字母语言码 `en` → 英文列，缺失回落中文列； 3. 其它文化 → JSON 列按"完整文化名 → 父文化名 → 两字母码"三级匹配； 4. 三级都未命中 → 回落中文列 → 回落英文列 → 空字符串。 该回退链与既有 `PortalNavigationEntry.GetDisplayName` 的语义一致（中文文化取中文、英文文化取英文、 一侧缺失回落另一侧），避免两套显示名解析逻辑对同一文化给出不同结论。 证明边界：本类型只证明"按文化选出最合适的显示文本"，**不证明**文本本身翻译正确、 JSON 键是受支持的文化（键名白名单属于语言管理功能），也不做任何授权判断。

Reason it exists: the portal shell and module body text come from `App_GlobalResources/lang.*` resources, while tab names (`PortalCfg_Tabs.TabName`) and module titles (`PortalCfg_Modules.ModuleTitle`) are single-column database text that **does not follow the language switch**, producing "English title + Chinese body" inside one card. This resolver connects those texts to the same culture decision the resources use, which is what makes the mixing fixable. Column design (user decision, 2026-10-18): one Chinese column, one English column, and one JSON column for every other language. The Chinese side reuses the existing columns (`TabName` / `ModuleTitle`) rather than adding new ones — those columns are `NOT NULL` and are the default source of every renderer, so reusing them guarantees there is always something to display. Resolution order: 1. two-letter language code `zh` (including zh-CN / zh-TW and other regional variants) → Chinese column, falling back to the English column when missing; 2. two-letter code `en` → English column, falling back to the Chinese column when missing; 3. any other culture → three-tier JSON lookup "full culture name → parent culture name → two-letter code"; 4. no hit → Chinese column → English column → empty string. That fallback chain matches the existing `PortalNavigationEntry.GetDisplayName` semantics (Chinese cultures take the Chinese name, English cultures the English one, and a missing side falls back to the other), so two display-name resolvers cannot disagree about the same culture. Proof boundary: this type proves only that "the most suitable display text was selected for the culture". It does **not** prove the text is a correct translation, that JSON keys are supported cultures (that allowlist belongs to language administration), and it makes no authorization decision.

remarks.defaultText: Expansion is a pure function so that the security-relevant "organization scope" semantics can be unit tested without a database; the data layer still owns retrieval, inactive filtering, and failure handling. Expansion is breadth-first with both a depth cap and a visited set, so a malformed cycle cannot cause unbounded recursion even if the write-side cycle guard were bypassed.

localizedText.zh-CN: 把展开做成纯函数是为了让"组织范围"这一安全相关语义可以在没有数据库的环境中被单测覆盖；数据层仍然负责取数、停用过滤与失败处理。展开按广度优先进行，并用深度上限与"已访问"集合双重保护，即使写入侧的防环被绕过也不会无限递归。

Internal deferred-item registration (four-way split: **a real work item outside the actionable range**) — basis: this project's new password system already uses PBKDF2 (see `PortalPasswordHasher`); this entry concerns the gradual upgrade of **existing MD5-digest accounts**, which is a data migration rather than something a comment can close, so it is not remediated in this cycle. Owner: the password-system workstream (entry point in the next cycle). Re-entry conditions — start when any applies: 1) legacy-digest accounts must be rehashed automatically at sign-in; 2) the MD5 compatibility surface is required to shrink or retire; 3) a security review lists unsalted MD5 as a must-fix. On re-entry, first produce a read-only inventory (count of MD5 accounts, sign-in success rate) before deciding migration batches; never rewrite without that inventory.

remarks.defaultText: The established work-item read contracts return an empty list both for unavailable schema and for query failures, so an empty result cannot distinguish "no data" from "read failure". This type pairs a success flag with the projection list so a front end can render empty and failure states separately without exposing exception details to the user. The list itself remains a mutable point-in-time projection and does not automatically reflect concurrent updates.

blocks.text: 强类型资源访问器，用于查找本地化字符串等资源值。
Strongly typed resource accessor used to look up localized strings and related resource values.

entries.name: AccessDenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The static access-denied page uses a themed message block instead of the old fixed-width table.

localizedText.zh-CN: 静态拒绝访问页采用主题化消息块，避免继续使用旧固定宽度表格。
localizedText.en: The static access-denied page uses a themed message block instead of the old fixed-width table.

entries.name: AccessDenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The title and explanation render resource text for the denial; the page only presents the server decision and does not interpret or relax authorization.

localizedText.zh-CN: 标题和说明使用资源文本输出拒绝原因；页面只展示服务器决定的结果，不尝试解释或放宽权限。
localizedText.en: The title and explanation render resource text for the denial; the page only presents the server decision and does not interpret or relax authorization.

entries.name: AccessDenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The return link targets only the application-generated portal root and does not turn the denial page into an executable administration entry.

localizedText.zh-CN: 返回链接只回到应用生成的门户根路径，不把拒绝页当作可执行管理入口。
localizedText.en: The return link targets only the application-generated portal root and does not turn the denial page into an executable administration entry.

entries.name: DiagnosticLogDetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The P2.4 diagnostic log detail page queries sanitized entries only by event id and does not accept log file paths.

localizedText.zh-CN: P2.4 诊断日志详情页仅按事件编号查询已净化记录，不接受日志文件路径。
localizedText.en: The P2.4 diagnostic log detail page queries sanitized entries only by event id and does not accept log file paths.

entries.name: DiagnosticLogDetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The detail page changes only the read-only presentation structure and does not change event-id lookup or the deployment-level detail switch.

localizedText.zh-CN: 详情页只调整只读展示结构，不改变事件编号查询和部署级详情开关。
localizedText.en: The detail page changes only the read-only presentation structure and does not change event-id lookup or the deployment-level detail switch.

entries.name: DiagnosticLogDetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The detail panel is hidden by default and its visibility is controlled by code-behind; the markup must not open sensitive event data containing exception, path, IP, or User-Agent fields by itself.

localizedText.zh-CN: 详情面板默认隐藏并由 code-behind 控制可见性；标记层不自行打开包含异常、路径、IP 和 User-Agent 的敏感事件数据。
localizedText.en: The detail panel is hidden by default and its visibility is controlled by code-behind; the markup must not open sensitive event data containing exception, path, IP, or User-Agent fields by itself.

entries.name: DiagnosticLogDetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: The detail table presents only fields authorized and sanitized by code-behind; the markup accepts no path or file input beyond the event-id route, and server code remains responsible for sensitive-field redaction.

localizedText.zh-CN: 详情表只呈现 code-behind 已授权并净化后的字段；标记层不接收事件编号以外的路径或文件输入，敏感字段的裁剪仍由服务端职责负责。
localizedText.en: The detail table presents only fields authorized and sanitized by code-behind; the markup accepts no path or file input beyond the event-id route, and server code remains responsible for sensitive-field redaction.

entries.name: DiagnosticLogDetail.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: Render exception detail in a read-only multiline control; it provides no edit-back capability and does not resubmit exception text as user input.

localizedText.zh-CN: 异常详情使用只读多行控件承载展示，不提供回发编辑能力，也不把异常文本重新作为用户输入提交。
localizedText.en: Render exception detail in a read-only multiline control; it provides no edit-back capability and does not resubmit exception text as user input.

entries.name: DiagnosticsLogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The P2.4 read-only diagnostic log page queries only constrained NDJSON entries and provides no download, delete, or path-input action.

localizedText.zh-CN: P2.4 只读诊断日志页仅查询受限 NDJSON 记录，不提供下载、删除或路径输入。
localizedText.en: The P2.4 read-only diagnostic log page queries only constrained NDJSON entries and provides no download, delete, or path-input action.

entries.name: DiagnosticsLogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The diagnostic log page only rebuilds the Admin presentation structure; query scope, paging, and authorization remain controlled by code-behind.

localizedText.zh-CN: 诊断日志页只重构后台展示结构，查询范围、分页和权限仍由 code-behind 控制。
localizedText.en: The diagnostic log page only rebuilds the Admin presentation structure; query scope, paging, and authorization remain controlled by code-behind.

entries.name: DiagnosticsLogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The filter controls only collect display-query criteria; server code in SearchButton_Click remains responsible for parsing, range limits, and authorization for dates, level, category, and event id.

localizedText.zh-CN: 筛选控件只收集展示查询条件；日期、级别、分类和事件编号的解析、范围限制及授权仍由 SearchButton_Click 的服务端职责完成。
localizedText.en: The filter controls only collect display-query criteria; server code in SearchButton_Click remains responsible for parsing, range limits, and authorization for dates, level, category, and event id.

entries.name: DiagnosticsLogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: Pager buttons submit only previous/next intent with page validation disabled; code-behind controls page boundaries, data reads, and out-of-range fallback.

localizedText.zh-CN: 分页按钮仅发送前后页意图且关闭页面验证；实际页码边界、数据读取和越界回退由 code-behind 控制。
localizedText.en: Pager buttons submit only previous/next intent with page validation disabled; code-behind controls page boundaries, data reads, and out-of-range fallback.

entries.name: DiagnosticsLogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The Repeater renders constrained diagnostic entries read-only; `<%#: ... %>` encodes text bindings, and detail links are produced by GetDetailUrl rather than concatenated in markup.

localizedText.zh-CN: Repeater 只读展示受限诊断条目；`<%#: ... %>` 负责编码文本绑定，详情链接统一经过 GetDetailUrl 生成，不在标记层拼接路径。
localizedText.en: The Repeater renders constrained diagnostic entries read-only; `<%#: ... %>` encodes text bindings, and detail links are produced by GetDetailUrl rather than concatenated in markup.

entries.name: DiagnosticsLogs.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.summary: P81.3 空态：仅在"查询成功且零条"时渲染；输入无效分支由代码后置把计数置为 null 抑制，避免把错误说成"暂无日志"。

entries.name: EditAccessDenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The edit-access-denied page reuses the shared message block while preserving the existing resource text.

localizedText.zh-CN: 编辑权限拒绝页复用统一消息块，并保留原有资源文案。
localizedText.en: The edit-access-denied page reuses the shared message block while preserving the existing resource text.

entries.name: EditAccessDenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The edit-denied page reuses resource-based title and explanation, presenting the server-confirmed edit result without disclosing extra details about the protected object.

localizedText.zh-CN: 编辑拒绝页复用资源化标题和说明，只呈现服务器确认的编辑权限结果，不泄露被保护对象的额外信息。
localizedText.en: The edit-denied page reuses resource-based title and explanation, presenting the server-confirmed edit result without disclosing extra details about the protected object.

entries.name: EditAccessDenied.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The portal return link provides only a safe exit path; any later edit attempt remains subject to server checks on the target page.

localizedText.zh-CN: 返回门户链接只提供安全的离开路径；是否允许再次进入编辑流程仍由目标页服务器校验。
localizedText.en: The portal return link provides only a safe exit path; any later edit attempt remains subject to server checks on the target page.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The P6.3-S4 employee and organization directory list is read-only; creation and editing are handled by dedicated maintenance pages.

localizedText.zh-CN: P6.3-S4 员工组织目录页的列表本身只读，新增和编辑交给独立维护页处理。
localizedText.en: The P6.3-S4 employee and organization directory list is read-only; creation and editing are handled by dedicated maintenance pages.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 10
entries.summary: P74.3 空态：零条时渲染表头 + 提示行；失败路径由 null 计数抑制。 / Empty state: header-plus-hint row when there are zero rows; a null count suppresses it on failure paths.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The employee directory page only rebuilds the presentation shell; data reads, creation, and edit entry behavior remain unchanged.

localizedText.zh-CN: 员工目录页只重构展示壳，数据读取、新增和编辑入口保持既有行为。
localizedText.en: The employee directory page only rebuilds the presentation shell; data reads, creation, and edit entry behavior remain unchanged.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: Page-owned navigation entries: this page deliberately aggregates cross-group entries - System Health belongs to Admin.Ops, User Administration to Admin.Account, and the rest to Admin.Capability. The renderer is group-scoped and expresses only same-group entries, so it cannot cover these cross-group links and the block stays in the page, localized only. New organization unit, new employee, and bind user/employee are also this page's maintenance actions.

localizedText.zh-CN: 页面自有导航入口：本页刻意汇集跨族入口——System Health 属 Admin.Ops 族、User Administration 属 Admin.Account 族，其余属 Admin.Capability 族；渲染器按族输出、只表达同族入口，无法覆盖这些跨族链接，故整块保留在页面内并只做文案本地化。其中新建组织单元、新建员工、绑定用户／员工同时是本页的维护动作入口。
localizedText.en: Page-owned navigation entries: this page deliberately aggregates cross-group entries - System Health belongs to Admin.Ops, User Administration to Admin.Account, and the rest to Admin.Capability. The renderer is group-scoped and expresses only same-group entries, so it cannot cover these cross-group links and the block stays in the page, localized only. New organization unit, new employee, and bind user/employee are also this page's maintenance actions.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: These filters only construct directory query criteria; the server still normalizes keyword, employee status, binding status, and inactive-organization choices before deciding visible results.

localizedText.zh-CN: 筛选字段只构造目录查询条件；关键字、员工状态、绑定状态和停用组织选项仍由服务器规范化并决定可见结果。
localizedText.en: These filters only construct directory query criteria; the server still normalizes keyword, employee status, binding status, and inactive-organization choices before deciding visible results.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: Organization rows use encoded read-only bindings and link to server-generated edit URLs; the table does not infer organization permissions or relationships on its own.

localizedText.zh-CN: 组织行使用编码绑定的只读字段，并把编辑入口指向服务器生成的 URL；页面不在表格中自行推断组织权限或关系。
localizedText.en: Organization rows use encoded read-only bindings and link to server-generated edit URLs; the table does not infer organization permissions or relationships on its own.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.summary: P74.3 空态：零条时渲染表头 + 提示行；失败路径由 null 计数抑制。 / Empty state: header-plus-hint row when there are zero rows; a null count suppresses it on failure paths.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.summary: Employee rows expose edit and binding entries, with binding URLs generated only for employee records; encoded output and operation authorization remain owned by the server model and code-behind.

localizedText.zh-CN: 员工行同时提供编辑和绑定入口，绑定 URL 只针对员工记录生成；编码输出与操作授权仍由服务器端模型和 code-behind 负责。
localizedText.en: Employee rows expose edit and binding entries, with binding URLs generated only for employee records; encoded output and operation authorization remain owned by the server model and code-behind.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 8
entries.summary: User-employee binding is exposed from employee rows to avoid organization rows referencing a binding URL that does not exist.

localizedText.zh-CN: 员工账号绑定以员工行为入口，避免组织行误引用不存在的绑定地址。
localizedText.en: User-employee binding is exposed from employee rows to avoid organization rows referencing a binding URL that does not exist.

entries.name: EmployeeDirectory.aspx webforms-server-comment 9
entries.summary: P74.3 空态：零条时渲染表头 + 提示行；失败路径由 null 计数抑制。 / Empty state: header-plus-hint row when there are zero rows; a null count suppresses it on failure paths.

entries.name: EmployeeEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The P6.3-S4 minimal employee master-data page does not provide account binding, employee-code login enablement, import, export, or sensitive personal-profile fields.

localizedText.zh-CN: P6.3-S4 员工主数据最小维护页不提供账号绑定、工号登录启用、导入、导出或敏感个人资料字段。
localizedText.en: The P6.3-S4 minimal employee master-data page does not provide account binding, employee-code login enablement, import, export, or sensitive personal-profile fields.

entries.name: EmployeeEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The employee edit page only rebuilds the presentation shell; field validation, saving, and audit writing remain handled by code-behind.

localizedText.zh-CN: 员工编辑页只重构展示壳，字段验证、保存和审计仍由 code-behind 处理。
localizedText.en: The employee edit page only rebuilds the presentation shell; field validation, saving, and audit writing remain handled by code-behind.

entries.name: EmployeeEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: EmployeeIdField and OriginalUpdatedUtcField are postback state carriers that the client can modify; code-behind must resolve and validate entity identity and concurrency version again.

localizedText.zh-CN: EmployeeIdField 和 OriginalUpdatedUtcField 只是回发状态载体，客户端可以修改；实体身份和并发版本必须由 code-behind 重新解析与校验。
localizedText.en: EmployeeIdField and OriginalUpdatedUtcField are postback state carriers that the client can modify; code-behind must resolve and validate entity identity and concurrency version again.

entries.name: EmployeeEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: MaxLength on employee fields is only an input ceiling; the server still validates code uniqueness, email format, organization/status combinations, date relationships, and source-system policy.

localizedText.zh-CN: 员工资料控件的 MaxLength 只是输入上限；员工代码唯一性、邮箱格式、组织/状态组合、日期关系和来源系统策略仍由服务端校验。
localizedText.en: MaxLength on employee fields is only an input ceiling; the server still validates code uniqueness, email format, organization/status combinations, date relationships, and source-system policy.

entries.name: EmployeeEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The save button only triggers the server-side employee update; concurrency version, authorization, audit, and failure fallback are not decided by markup or the cancel link.

localizedText.zh-CN: 保存按钮只触发服务端员工资料更新；并发版本、授权、审计和失败回退不由标记层或取消链接决定。
localizedText.en: The save button only triggers the server-side employee update; concurrency version, authorization, audit, and failure fallback are not decided by markup or the cancel link.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The P6.4.3 employee profile correction Admin page handles request status only and does not directly modify employee master data.

localizedText.zh-CN: P6.4.3 员工资料更正请求后台处理页只处理请求状态，不直接修改员工主数据。
localizedText.en: The P6.4.3 employee profile correction Admin page handles request status only and does not directly modify employee master data.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The review page only adjusts presentation structure; status commands and audit records remain handled by code-behind.

localizedText.zh-CN: 审核页只调整展示结构，状态命令和审计记录仍由 code-behind 处理。
localizedText.en: The review page only adjusts presentation structure; status commands and audit records remain handled by code-behind.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: Page-owned navigation entries: Operation Audits belongs to Admin.Ops while this page belongs to Admin.Capability. The group-scoped renderer expresses only same-group entries and cannot express that cross-group link, so the block stays in the page and is localized only.

localizedText.zh-CN: 页面自有导航入口：Operation Audits 属 Admin.Ops 族，而本页入口属 Admin.Capability 族；渲染器按族输出、只表达同族入口，无法表达该跨族链接，故整块保留在页面内并只做文案本地化。
localizedText.en: Page-owned navigation entries: Operation Audits belongs to Admin.Ops while this page belongs to Admin.Capability. The group-scoped renderer expresses only same-group entries and cannot express that cross-group link, so the block stays in the page and is localized only.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: The status filter expresses only review-list query intent; SearchButton_Click remains responsible for parsing, page size, authorization, and empty-result handling.

localizedText.zh-CN: 状态筛选只表达审核列表的查询意图；状态值解析、页大小、授权和空结果处理仍由 SearchButton_Click 的服务端职责负责。
localizedText.en: The status filter expresses only review-list query intent; SearchButton_Click remains responsible for parsing, page size, authorization, and empty-result handling.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The Repeater renders current, proposed, and review text read-only with encoded bindings so request content is not executed as markup; the server must revalidate request id and status commands.

localizedText.zh-CN: Repeater 只读呈现当前值、提议值和审核文本，使用编码绑定避免把申请内容当作标记执行；请求编号和状态命令仍需服务端重新校验。
localizedText.en: The Repeater renders current, proposed, and review text read-only with encoded bindings so request content is not executed as markup; the server must revalidate request id and status commands.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.summary: The review note has a length limit but remains administrator input; code-behind validates state transition, request ownership, audit events, and the master-data side-channel rule.

localizedText.zh-CN: 审核备注有长度上限但仍是管理员输入；状态转换、请求归属、审计事件和主数据旁路规则由 code-behind 校验。
localizedText.en: The review note has a length limit but remains administrator input; code-behind validates state transition, request ownership, audit events, and the master-data side-channel rule.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequests.aspx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.summary: P74.3 empty state: with zero rows the footer renders the header-plus-hint row whose wording depends on whether a filter is active (this page preselects the submitted status, so its default view is already filtered); failure paths suppress it by passing a null count so it cannot contradict the error message. The column count (8) matches this table's header.

localizedText.zh-CN: P74.3 空态：零条时在表尾渲染"表头 + 提示行"，文案按是否处于筛选态区分（本页默认选中"已提交"，故默认即筛选态）；失败路径由 EmptyStateRowCount 为 null 抑制，避免与错误提示矛盾。列数（8）与本表表头一致。
localizedText.en: P74.3 empty state: with zero rows the footer renders the header-plus-hint row whose wording depends on whether a filter is active (this page preselects the submitted status, so its default view is already filtered); failure paths suppress it by passing a null count so it cannot contradict the error message. The column count (8) matches this table's header.

entries.name: Logoff.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The logoff page is hosted by the master page but declares no visible server controls; the actual sign-out action is completed by the code-behind during the page lifecycle.

localizedText.zh-CN: 注销页通过母版页承载，但页面自身不声明可见服务器控件；实际退出动作由 code-behind 在页面生命周期内完成。
localizedText.en: The logoff page is hosted by the master page but declares no visible server controls; the actual sign-out action is completed by the code-behind during the page lifecycle.

entries.name: Logoff.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: This endpoint is reached from the header logoff button; it only terminates authentication state and returns to the portal home page, without reading or displaying business data.

localizedText.zh-CN: 该入口来自页眉注销按钮；页面只负责终止认证状态并回到门户首页，不读取或展示业务数据。
localizedText.en: This endpoint is reached from the header logoff button; it only terminates authentication state and returns to the portal home page, without reading or displaying business data.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: `ManageUsers.aspx` creates, reviews, and maintains portal accounts and also acts as the role-membership maintenance entry.

localizedText.zh-CN: `ManageUsers.aspx` 用于创建、审核和维护门户账号，并作为角色成员关系维护的入口。
localizedText.en: `ManageUsers.aspx` creates, reviews, and maintains portal accounts and also acts as the role-membership maintenance entry.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 10
entries.summary: The P6.2 display name is used by Admin lists and low-sensitivity display surfaces, not as a login credential.

localizedText.zh-CN: P6.2 显示名用于后台列表和低敏展示，不作为登录凭据。
localizedText.en: The P6.2 display name is used by Admin lists and low-sensitivity display surfaces, not as a login credential.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 11
entries.summary: The P6.2 nickname is optional display profile data and its save policy is handled centrally by code-behind.

localizedText.zh-CN: P6.2 昵称是可选展示资料，保存策略由 code-behind 统一处理。
localizedText.en: The P6.2 nickname is optional display profile data and its save policy is handled centrally by code-behind.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 12
entries.summary: The email field may serve as contact information or one login identifier input; final resolution remains controlled by the authentication service.

localizedText.zh-CN: 邮箱字段可作为联系信息或登录标识输入之一，最终解析仍由认证服务控制。
localizedText.en: The email field may serve as contact information or one login identifier input; final resolution remains controlled by the authentication service.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 13
entries.summary: The password input works with the hidden encrypted field; the server still revalidates plaintext/ciphertext boundaries and policy.

localizedText.zh-CN: 密码输入配合隐藏加密字段使用；服务端仍会重新校验明文/密文边界和策略。
localizedText.en: The password input works with the hidden encrypted field; the server still revalidates plaintext/ciphertext boundaries and policy.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 14
entries.summary: The confirm-password field supports client/server consistency validation and is also submitted with a hidden encrypted field.

localizedText.zh-CN: 确认密码字段用于前后台一致性校验，并同样配合隐藏加密字段提交。
localizedText.en: The confirm-password field supports client/server consistency validation and is also submitted with a hidden encrypted field.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 15
entries.summary: The role-membership section carries selected roles and current members through postback commands; code-behind rechecks role identity, duplication, authorization, and audit requirements before writing.

localizedText.zh-CN: 角色成员区将可选角色和当前成员作为回发命令载体；角色身份、去重、授权和审计仍由 code-behind 在写入前重新判断。
localizedText.en: The role-membership section carries selected roles and current members through postback commands; code-behind rechecks role identity, duplication, authorization, and audit requirements before writing.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 16
entries.summary:
The role name binds with **`<%#:`** (with colon) rather than `<%#`: the former HTML-encodes before emitting, which is the
  XSS baseline for controllable data such as role names — do not regress it to `<%#`. The delete button carries no
  `CommandArgument`; the role to remove is recovered via the DataList's `DataKeyField="RoleId"` in `OnItemCommand`, i.e.
  "which row" comes from the DataKey and the markup holds no row identifier.

localizedText.zh-CN:
角色名用 **`<%#:`**（冒号）而非 `<%#` 绑定：前者会先做 HTML 编码再输出，是角色名这类可控数据的 XSS 防护基线，
  改动时不得退化成 `<%#`。删除按钮不带 `CommandArgument`，要移除的角色由 `DataList` 的 `DataKeyField="RoleId"`
  经 `OnItemCommand` 取回 —— 即"删哪一行"由 DataKey 决定，标记层不含行标识。
localizedText.en:
The role name binds with **`<%#:`** (with colon) rather than `<%#`: the former HTML-encodes before emitting, which is the
  XSS baseline for controllable data such as role names — do not regress it to `<%#`. The delete button carries no
  `CommandArgument`; the role to remove is recovered via the DataList's `DataKeyField="RoleId"` in `OnItemCommand`, i.e.
  "which row" comes from the DataKey and the markup holds no row identifier.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The manage-user page only rearranges presentation structure; account updates, registration review, lifecycle commands, and role commands remain controlled by code-behind.

localizedText.zh-CN: 管理用户页只重排展示结构，账号更新、注册审核、生命周期和角色命令仍由 code-behind 控制。
localizedText.en: The manage-user page only rearranges presentation structure; account updates, registration review, lifecycle commands, and role commands remain controlled by code-behind.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The title uses a server-side Label to avoid runtime text-update errors on an HtmlControl that contains code blocks.

localizedText.zh-CN: 标题使用服务器端 Label，避免包含代码块的 HtmlControl 在运行时修改文本时报错。
localizedText.en: The title uses a server-side Label to avoid runtime text-update errors on an HtmlControl that contains code blocks.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: The P2.3 registration-review status area displays the current state and exposes only minimal approve/reject actions.

localizedText.zh-CN: P2.3 注册审核状态区域只展示当前状态，并提供最小批准/拒绝动作。
localizedText.en: The P2.3 registration-review status area displays the current state and exposes only minimal approve/reject actions.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The employee-binding card only navigates to the single-binding maintenance page; binding targets, security-version refresh, and audit actions are not executed by this markup.

localizedText.zh-CN: 员工绑定卡片只提供进入单绑定维护页的导航；绑定目标、版本刷新和审计动作不在此标记层执行。
localizedText.en: The employee-binding card only navigates to the single-binding maintenance page; binding targets, security-version refresh, and audit actions are not executed by this markup.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.summary: The account-status card shows disable/restore buttons only after server authorization; the disable action keeps a browser confirmation, which never replaces server authorization.

localizedText.zh-CN: 账号状态卡片仅在服务端授权后显示禁用/恢复按钮；禁用动作额外保留浏览器确认，但确认不替代服务端授权。
localizedText.en: The account-status card shows disable/restore buttons only after server authorization; the disable action keeps a browser confirmation, which never replaces server authorization.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.summary: The registration-metadata section renders invitation, employee, and timestamp information read-only; code-behind loads these values and the markup does not treat them as editable account-update inputs.

localizedText.zh-CN: 注册元数据区只读展示邀请、员工和时间信息；这些值由后台加载，不作为账号更新表单的可编辑输入。
localizedText.en: The registration-metadata section renders invitation, employee, and timestamp information read-only; code-behind loads these values and the markup does not treat them as editable account-update inputs.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 8
entries.summary: The legacy user name remains read-only for compatibility with historical URLs, roles, and audit references.

localizedText.zh-CN: 旧账号名继续只读展示，用于兼容历史 URL、角色和审计引用。
localizedText.en: The legacy user name remains read-only for compatibility with historical URLs, roles, and audit references.

entries.name: ManageUsers.aspx webforms-server-comment 9
entries.summary: The P6.2 login-name field has uniqueness and format validation in code-behind.

localizedText.zh-CN: P6.2 新登录名字段由后台校验唯一性和格式。
localizedText.en: The P6.2 login-name field has uniqueness and format validation in code-behind.

entries.name: ModuleCatalog.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: P3.2 manages only registration and enablement for trusted deployed packages; it provides no ZIP, DLL, script, external-link, or online-compilation entry point.

localizedText.zh-CN: P3.2 只管理受信任部署包的注册和启停；不提供 ZIP、DLL、脚本、外链或在线编译入口。
localizedText.en: P3.2 manages only registration and enablement for trusted deployed packages; it provides no ZIP, DLL, script, external-link, or online-compilation entry point.

entries.name: ModuleCatalog.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The module catalog page only rebuilds the presentation shell; package registration, enable/disable, and preflight commands keep their existing security boundary.

localizedText.zh-CN: 模块目录页只重构展示壳，包注册、启停和预检命令保持既有安全边界。
localizedText.en: The module catalog page only rebuilds the presentation shell; package registration, enable/disable, and preflight commands keep their existing security boundary.

entries.name: ModuleCatalog.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The GridView projects only trusted deployed-package state and metadata; a bound package id is not a trust boundary, so RowCommand must parse and validate it again on the server.

localizedText.zh-CN: GridView 只投影受信部署包的状态和元数据；包标识来自绑定行但不构成信任边界，RowCommand 必须由服务端重新解析和校验。
localizedText.en: The GridView projects only trusted deployed-package state and metadata; a bound package id is not a trust boundary, so RowCommand must parse and validate it again on the server.

entries.name: ModuleCatalog.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary:
P81.3 empty state: a GridView renders no table when it has zero rows, so <c>EmptyDataTemplate</c>
  is used together with <c>ShowHeaderWhenEmpty</c> so the "header plus centred hint row" shape matches
  the other six lists.

localizedText.zh-CN:
P81.3 空态：GridView 零条时默认不渲染表格，因而用 <c>EmptyDataTemplate</c> 并开启
  <c>ShowHeaderWhenEmpty</c>，使"表头 + 居中提示行"形态与其余六个列表一致。
localizedText.en:
P81.3 empty state: a GridView renders no table when it has zero rows, so <c>EmptyDataTemplate</c>
  is used together with <c>ShowHeaderWhenEmpty</c> so the "header plus centred hint row" shape matches
  the other six lists.

entries.name: ModuleCatalog.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: Action-button visibility only projects the current row's capabilities; registration, enable/disable, and preflight never upload, extract, compile, or load scripts in the markup layer.

localizedText.zh-CN: 动作按钮的 Visible 标志只反映当前行能力投影；注册、启停和预检不会在标记层上传、解包、编译或加载脚本。
localizedText.en: Action-button visibility only projects the current row's capabilities; registration, enable/disable, and preflight never upload, extract, compile, or load scripts in the markup layer.

entries.name: ModuleCatalog.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.summary:
P81.3 empty state: a GridView renders no table when it has zero rows, so the hint lives in an
  EmptyDataTemplate; together with <c>ShowHeaderWhenEmpty="true"</c> the header is preserved so the
  shape matches the other six lists.

localizedText.zh-CN:
P81.3 空态：GridView 零条时默认不渲染表格，故用 EmptyDataTemplate 承载提示；
  配合 <c>ShowHeaderWhenEmpty="true"</c> 保留表头，使形态与其余六个列表一致。
localizedText.en:
P81.3 empty state: a GridView renders no table when it has zero rows, so the hint lives in an
  EmptyDataTemplate; together with <c>ShowHeaderWhenEmpty="true"</c> the header is preserved so the
  shape matches the other six lists.

entries.name: ModuleDefinitions.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The legacy module-definition page only maintains names and protected deletion; source-path fields keep their read-only safety boundary.

localizedText.zh-CN: 历史模块定义页只维护名称和受保护删除，路径字段保持只读安全边界。
localizedText.en: The legacy module-definition page only maintains names and protected deletion; source-path fields keep their read-only safety boundary.

entries.name: ModuleDefinitions.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The definition form edits only the friendly name; desktop/mobile source paths remain read-only safety boundaries and the server validates trusted relative ASCX paths.

localizedText.zh-CN: 定义表单只允许友好名称编辑；桌面/移动源路径保持只读安全边界，并由服务器验证受信相对 ASCX 路径。
localizedText.en: The definition form edits only the friendly name; desktop/mobile source paths remain read-only safety boundaries and the server validates trusted relative ASCX paths.

entries.name: ModuleDefinitions.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: CustomValidator only invokes the server path rule from markup; client-side validation is not treated as path trust or authorization proof.

localizedText.zh-CN: CustomValidator 只是触发服务器路径规则的标记入口；它不把客户端校验视为路径信任或授权证明。
localizedText.en: CustomValidator only invokes the server path rule from markup; client-side validation is not treated as path trust or authorization proof.

entries.name: ModuleDefinitions.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: Update, cancel, and delete buttons submit only command intent; code-behind decides definition identity, instance references, trusted paths, delete protection, and auditing.

localizedText.zh-CN: 更新、取消和删除按钮只发送命令意图；定义身份、实例引用、受信路径、删除保护和审计仍由 code-behind 决定。
localizedText.en: Update, cancel, and delete buttons submit only command intent; code-behind decides definition identity, instance references, trusted paths, delete protection, and auditing.

entries.name: ModuleDefs.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The legacy bridge entry only lists existing definitions and routes users to the trusted module catalog; online manual path entry is not restored.

localizedText.zh-CN: Legacy 桥接入口只展示既有定义并引导到受信任模块目录，不恢复在线手填路径。
localizedText.en: The legacy bridge entry only lists existing definitions and routes users to the trusted module catalog; online manual path entry is not restored.

entries.name: ModuleDefs.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: This entry routes only to the trusted module catalog; the legacy control does not expose high-risk definition-path or assembly inputs.

localizedText.zh-CN: 此入口只转到受信任的模块目录；不在旧控件中开放定义路径或程序集等高风险输入。
localizedText.en: This entry routes only to the trusted module catalog; the legacy control does not expose high-risk definition-path or assembly inputs.

entries.name: ModuleDefs.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The DataList keeps ModuleDefID as the command key and retains server events; the display name uses encoded binding so definition metadata is not emitted as markup.

localizedText.zh-CN: DataList 使用 ModuleDefID 作为命令键并保留服务器事件，展示名称采用编码绑定以避免把定义元数据当作标记输出。
localizedText.en: The DataList keeps ModuleDefID as the command key and retains server events; the display name uses encoded binding so definition metadata is not emitted as markup.

entries.name: ModuleDefs.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: Each item exposes only an encoded friendly name and an edit command; definition loading, authorization, and persistence remain decided by the code-behind.

localizedText.zh-CN: 每个条目仅提供受编码的友好名称和编辑命令，实际定义读取、授权与保存仍由 code-behind 决定。
localizedText.en: Each item exposes only an encoded friendly name and an edit command; definition loading, authorization, and persistence remain decided by the code-behind.

entries.name: ModuleSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The module-instance settings page only rebuilds the presentation shell and form grouping; instance ownership checks, editor-role persistence, cache-policy writes, and auditing remain controlled by the code-behind.

localizedText.zh-CN: 模块实例设置页只重构展示壳和表单分组，实例归属校验、编辑角色保存、缓存策略写入和审计仍由 code-behind 控制。
localizedText.en: The module-instance settings page only rebuilds the presentation shell and form grouping; instance ownership checks, editor-role persistence, cache-policy writes, and auditing remain controlled by the code-behind.

entries.name: ModuleSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: Page-owned navigation entries: Employee Directory belongs to Admin.Capability while this page belongs to Admin.Modules; the group-scoped renderer cannot express that cross-group link, so the block stays in the page and is localized only.

localizedText.zh-CN: 页面自有导航入口：Employee Directory 属 Admin.Capability 族，而本页入口属 Admin.Modules 族；渲染器按族输出、无法表达该跨族链接，故整块保留在页面内并只做文案本地化。
localizedText.en: Page-owned navigation entries: Employee Directory belongs to Admin.Capability while this page belongs to Admin.Modules; the group-scoped renderer cannot express that cross-group link, so the block stays in the page and is localized only.

entries.name: ModuleSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: Instance metadata inputs express only title, seconds, and mobile-compatibility intent; code-behind validates instance ownership, ranges, cache units, and legal values.

localizedText.zh-CN: 实例元数据输入只表达标题、秒数和移动兼容意图；实例归属、范围、缓存单位和合法值仍由 code-behind 校验。
localizedText.en: Instance metadata inputs express only title, seconds, and mobile-compatibility intent; code-behind validates instance ownership, ranges, cache units, and legal values.

entries.name: ModuleSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: Module-title multilingual area: the Chinese title is the `moduleTitle` field above (Chinese column and default fallback); only the English column and the "other languages" JSON column are added here, and both are written only when an administrator fills them in explicitly.

localizedText.zh-CN:
模块标题多语言区：中文标题就是上面的 `moduleTitle`（中文列兼默认回退列），
    这里只补英文列与"其它语言" JSON 列，两个字段都只在管理员显式填写时才写入。
localizedText.en: Module-title multilingual area: the Chinese title is the `moduleTitle` field above (Chinese column and default fallback); only the English column and the "other languages" JSON column are added here, and both are written only when an administrator fills them in explicitly.

entries.name: ModuleSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The editor-role list only renders selectable role keys; the server rechecks instance membership, write permission, and change auditing.

localizedText.zh-CN: 编辑角色列表只呈现可选角色键；角色是否属于当前实例、是否允许写入以及变更审计仍由服务端重新判断。
localizedText.en: The editor-role list only renders selectable role keys; the server rechecks instance membership, write permission, and change auditing.

entries.name: ModuleSettings.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.summary: The apply button submits the complete module-settings set; ApplyChanges_Click owns the transaction, editor-role authorization, cache-policy write, and audit event.

localizedText.zh-CN: 应用按钮提交整组模块设置，事务、编辑角色授权、缓存策略写入和审计事件均由 ApplyChanges_Click 负责。
localizedText.en: The apply button submits the complete module-settings set; ApplyChanges_Click owns the transaction, editor-role authorization, cache-policy write, and audit event.

entries.name: NotImplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The not-implemented sample-link page now uses the unified message card as a low-risk landing page for sample-data links; after dynamic theme switching it no longer uses the old OutputCache, avoiding cached wrong themes.

localizedText.zh-CN: 未实现示例链接页改为统一提示卡，用于样例数据链接的低风险落地页；动态主题切换后不再使用旧 OutputCache，避免缓存错误主题。
localizedText.en: The not-implemented sample-link page now uses the unified message card as a low-risk landing page for sample-data links; after dynamic theme switching it no longer uses the old OutputCache, avoiding cached wrong themes.

entries.name: NotImplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The server control keeps the title as the sample landing-page identifier; this page does not load an unimplemented module or execute a business command carried by the link.

localizedText.zh-CN: 标题由服务器控件保留为样例落地页标识；该页不加载未实现模块，也不执行链接携带的业务命令。
localizedText.en: The server control keeps the title as the sample landing-page identifier; this page does not load an unimplemented module or execute a business command carried by the link.

entries.name: NotImplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The title element is server-controlled and its default text is written by code-behind from resources; a code block must not be placed here, otherwise setting InnerText throws because the contents are not literal.

localizedText.zh-CN: 标题元素由服务器控制，默认标题由 code-behind 从资源写入；此处不能放代码块，否则设置 InnerText 会因"内容非字面"而抛异常。
localizedText.en: The title element is server-controlled and its default text is written by code-behind from resources; a code block must not be placed here, otherwise setting InnerText throws because the contents are not literal.

entries.name: NotImplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: The body only explains that sample-linked content is not provided, keeping a static-information boundary rather than treating sample data as an available business resource.

localizedText.zh-CN: 正文只解释样例链接没有提供内容，保持静态信息边界，不把样例数据当作可用业务资源。
localizedText.en: The body only explains that sample-linked content is not provided, keeping a static-information boundary rather than treating sample data as an available business resource.

entries.name: NotImplemented.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The home link uses the application path and only leaves the landing page; it does not change configuration or business state.

localizedText.zh-CN: 返回首页链接使用应用路径生成，离开落地页但不改变任何配置或业务状态。
localizedText.en: The home link uses the application path and only leaves the landing page; it does not change configuration or business state.

entries.name: OperationAudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The P2.4 read-only operation-audit page queries high-value state changes; ordinary view actions are not audited at this stage and can later be governed by audit-policy settings if needed.

localizedText.zh-CN: P2.4 只读运营审计页用于查询高价值状态变更；普通查看行为当前不写审计，相关策略扩展由审计策略配置统一控制。
localizedText.en: The P2.4 read-only operation-audit page queries high-value state changes; ordinary view actions are not audited at this stage and can later be governed by audit-policy settings if needed.

entries.name: OperationAudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The operation-audit page only adjusts the display structure for filters, paging, and the result table; query parsing, paging boundaries, and administrator authorization remain controlled by the code-behind.

localizedText.zh-CN: 运营审计页只调整筛选区、分页区和结果表格的展示结构，查询条件解析、分页边界和管理员权限逻辑仍由 code-behind 控制。
localizedText.en: The operation-audit page only adjusts the display structure for filters, paging, and the result table; query parsing, paging boundaries, and administrator authorization remain controlled by the code-behind.

entries.name: OperationAudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The audit filter controls only collect display-query criteria; code-behind remains responsible for parsing, range limits, and administrator authorization for dates, category, action, and target id.

localizedText.zh-CN: 审计筛选控件只收集展示查询条件；日期、分类、动作和目标编号的解析、范围限制及管理员授权仍由 code-behind 完成。
localizedText.en: The audit filter controls only collect display-query criteria; code-behind remains responsible for parsing, range limits, and administrator authorization for dates, category, action, and target id.

entries.name: OperationAudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: Pager buttons express only previous/next requests without page validation; the server handles audit-result page boundaries and empty-result fallback.

localizedText.zh-CN: 分页按钮只表达前后页请求且不触发页面验证；实际审计结果页边界和空结果回退由服务端处理。
localizedText.en: Pager buttons express only previous/next requests without page validation; the server handles audit-result page boundaries and empty-result fallback.

entries.name: OperationAudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The Repeater only renders audit records and exposes no write or delete action; encoded bindings render text, while the server query layer owns redaction boundaries for summary, actor, and target data.

localizedText.zh-CN: Repeater 仅呈现审计记录，不提供写入或删除动作；文本字段使用编码绑定，摘要、操作者和目标信息的脱敏边界由服务端查询层负责。
localizedText.en: The Repeater only renders audit records and exposes no write or delete action; encoded bindings render text, while the server query layer owns redaction boundaries for summary, actor, and target data.

entries.name: OperationAudits.aspx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.summary: P81.3 空态：仅在"查询成功且零条"时渲染；输入无效与审计表不可用两个分支由代码后置把计数置为 null 抑制，避免把错误/故障说成"暂无记录"。

entries.name: OrganizationUnitEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The P6.3-S4 minimal organization-unit maintenance page only supports single-record create/edit and activation toggles; it does not provide hard delete, import, export, or batch synchronization, avoiding premature expansion of organization-data governance.

localizedText.zh-CN: P6.3-S4 组织单元最小维护页只支持单条新增/编辑和启停；不提供硬删除、导入、导出或批量同步，避免过早扩大组织数据治理面。
localizedText.en: The P6.3-S4 minimal organization-unit maintenance page only supports single-record create/edit and activation toggles; it does not provide hard delete, import, export, or batch synchronization, avoiding premature expansion of organization-data governance.

entries.name: OrganizationUnitEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The organization-unit edit page only rebuilds the display shell and form layout; parent-cycle validation, concurrency timestamps, persistence, and auditing remain handled by the code-behind.

localizedText.zh-CN: 组织单元编辑页只重构展示壳和表单布局，父级循环校验、并发时间戳、保存和审计仍由 code-behind 处理。
localizedText.en: The organization-unit edit page only rebuilds the display shell and form layout; parent-cycle validation, concurrency timestamps, persistence, and auditing remain handled by the code-behind.

entries.name: OrganizationUnitEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: These hidden fields round-trip the record ID and original update timestamp for server-side concurrency and target checks; they are not client-writable authorization sources.

localizedText.zh-CN: 隐藏字段回传记录 ID 和原始更新时间，仅用于服务器并发/目标校验；它们不是客户端可写的授权来源。
localizedText.en: These hidden fields round-trip the record ID and original update timestamp for server-side concurrency and target checks; they are not client-writable authorization sources.

entries.name: OrganizationUnitEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: Code, name, parent, order, and active state form one organization-maintenance input; the markup does not decide parent cycles, normalization, or business boundaries.

localizedText.zh-CN: 代码、名称、父级、排序和启用状态组成单条组织维护输入；父级循环、规范化和业务边界不由标记层判断。
localizedText.en: Code, name, parent, order, and active state form one organization-maintenance input; the markup does not decide parent cycles, normalization, or business boundaries.

entries.name: OrganizationUnitEdit.aspx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The save command enters the existing server persistence and audit flow; cancel only leaves the edit context and does not revoke or forge state on the client.

localizedText.zh-CN: 保存命令进入既有服务器持久化和审计流程，取消只离开当前编辑上下文，不在客户端撤销或伪造状态。
localizedText.en: The save command enters the existing server persistence and audit flow; cancel only leaves the edit context and does not revoke or forge state on the client.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: Register.aspx provides the legacy Web Forms surface for public or invitation registration; the page only collects account, email, employee code, and password input, while uniqueness checks, invitation policy, password handling, and database persistence are handled by RegisterBtn_Click and the UsersDB server path.

localizedText.zh-CN: Register.aspx 为公开或邀请式注册提供旧 Web Forms 表单；页面只收集账号、邮箱、员工号与密码输入，唯一性校验、邀请策略、密码处理和数据库写入均由 RegisterBtn_Click 及 UsersDB 服务器链路完成。
localizedText.en: Register.aspx provides the legacy Web Forms surface for public or invitation registration; the page only collects account, email, employee code, and password input, while uniqueness checks, invitation policy, password handling, and database persistence are handled by RegisterBtn_Click and the UsersDB server path.

entries.name: Register.aspx webforms-server-comment 10
