localizedText.en: Since P74.2 the employment-status field uses this module's own key EmployeeProfileConfirm_LabelEmploymentStatus; it previously borrowed the correction module's list-column title, which is a **semantic borrow** (a list column title standing in for employment status) that made either side's wording change break the other. The value stays "状态", so this is pure key-ownership cleanup; renaming it to a clearer "在职状态" is a visible wording change and is registered as a separate candidate.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileConfirm.ascx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.summary: The confirm button only triggers ConfirmButton_Click; the server handles permission, target binding, and idempotent outcome, so the button itself does not mean the profile was written.

localizedText.zh-CN: 确认按钮只触发 ConfirmButton_Click；是否允许确认、目标绑定和幂等结果由服务器处理，按钮本身不代表资料已写入。
localizedText.en: The confirm button only triggers ConfirmButton_Click; the server handles permission, target binding, and idempotent outcome, so the button itself does not mean the profile was written.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The P74.3 empty-state renderer lives in the ASPNET.StarterKit.Portal namespace while Web.config imports only Resources globally: markup that references that type must import this namespace explicitly, otherwise the **runtime compilation** of the ASCX reports CS0103 (an msbuild build does not validate ASCX files).

localizedText.zh-CN: P74.3 空态渲染器位于 ASPNET.StarterKit.Portal 命名空间，而 Web.config 只全局导入 Resources：标记层若引用该类型必须显式导入本命名空间，否则**运行期编译**报 CS0103（msbuild 构建不会校验 ASCX）。
localizedText.en: The P74.3 empty-state renderer lives in the ASPNET.StarterKit.Portal namespace while Web.config imports only Resources globally: markup that references that type must import this namespace explicitly, otherwise the **runtime compilation** of the ASCX reports CS0103 (an msbuild build does not validate ASCX files).

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: P6.4.3 business module sample: employees submit low-sensitivity field-level correction requests; no attachment, script, or external resource capability is provided.

localizedText.zh-CN: P6.4.3 业务模块样板：员工提交低敏字段级更正请求，不提供附件、脚本或外部资源。
localizedText.en: P6.4.3 business module sample: employees submit low-sensitivity field-level correction requests; no attachment, script, or external resource capability is provided.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary:
Title semantics (added in W87): as in EnterpriseCapabilityWorkbench — the module renders its own title div, so
    role="heading" and aria-level="1" are set explicitly; attributes only, no class change, no visual change.

localizedText.zh-CN:
标题语义（W87 补）：同 EnterpriseCapabilityWorkbench —— 模块自带标题 div，显式补
    role="heading" 与 aria-level="1"，只加属性不改 class，视觉零变化。
localizedText.en:
Title semantics (added in W87): as in EnterpriseCapabilityWorkbench — the module renders its own title div, so
    role="heading" and aria-level="1" are set explicitly; attributes only, no class change, no visual change.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: The current profile snapshot renders in a field grid; the submission area keeps the original control IDs and events to preserve code-behind binding and postback compatibility.

localizedText.zh-CN: 当前资料快照用字段网格展示；提交区仍保留原控件 ID 和事件，以维持 code-behind 绑定和回发兼容。
localizedText.en: The current profile snapshot renders in a field grid; the submission area keeps the original control IDs and events to preserve code-behind binding and postback compatibility.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The correction form carries only a server-generated field allowlist and bounded low-sensitivity text; MaxLength improves interaction, while normalization, authorization, and sensitive-field boundaries remain owned by code-behind and the data service.

localizedText.zh-CN: 更正表单只承载服务器生成的字段白名单和有界低敏文本；MaxLength 约束改善交互，但规范化、授权与敏感字段边界仍由 code-behind 和数据服务负责。
localizedText.en: The correction form carries only a server-generated field allowlist and bounded low-sensitivity text; MaxLength improves interaction, while normalization, authorization, and sensitive-field boundaries remain owned by code-behind and the data service.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.summary: The submit button only enters the SubmitButton_Click postback flow; it does not modify employee master data directly, because the server rechecks identity, employee binding, field allowlist, and write result.

localizedText.zh-CN: 提交按钮只进入 SubmitButton_Click 回发流程；它不直接修改员工主数据，当前身份、员工绑定、字段白名单和写入结果均由服务器重新确认。
localizedText.en: The submit button only enters the SubmitButton_Click postback flow; it does not modify employee master data directly, because the server rechecks identity, employee binding, field allowlist, and write result.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 7
entries.summary: The recent-request list shows a bounded server-returned snapshot with encoded fields; it is a status hint, not proof that employee master data changed or review completed.

localizedText.zh-CN: 最近请求列表只展示服务器返回的有限快照，字段使用编码绑定；列表是状态提示，不等同于员工主数据已修改或审核已完成。
localizedText.en: The recent-request list shows a bounded server-returned snapshot with encoded fields; it is a status hint, not proof that employee master data changed or review completed.

entries.name: EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequest.ascx webforms-server-comment 8
entries.summary: P74.3 empty state: with zero rows the footer renders the header-plus-hint row, centered and muted. It lives in the FooterTemplate because a Repeater still renders header and footer with zero rows, and the renderer returns an empty string when rows exist so no branch is needed. The column count (5) matches this table's header.

localizedText.zh-CN: P74.3 空态：零条时在表尾渲染"表头 + 提示行"，整行居中且弱化。放在 FooterTemplate 内，因为 Repeater 在零条时仍渲染表头与表尾；有数据时渲染器返回空串，无需分支。列数（5）与本表表头一致。
localizedText.en: P74.3 empty state: with zero rows the footer renders the header-plus-hint row, centered and muted. It lives in the FooterTemplate because a Repeater still renders header and footer with zero rows, and the renderer returns an empty string when rows exist so no branch is needed. The column count (5) matches this table's header.

entries.name: Events.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The shared module-title control hosts the event-edit entry and themed title; action visibility is decided by the server edit context.

localizedText.zh-CN: 共享模块标题控件承载事件编辑入口和主题化标题；动作是否可见由服务器编辑上下文决定。
localizedText.en: The shared module-title control hosts the event-edit entry and themed title; action visibility is decided by the server edit context.

entries.name: Events.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The title control points only to the existing EditEvents page; list binding, expiry filtering, and permission decisions remain with code-behind and the data service.

localizedText.zh-CN: 标题控件只连接既有 EditEvents 页面；列表绑定、过期筛选和权限判断仍由 code-behind 与数据服务负责。
localizedText.en: The title control points only to the existing EditEvents page; list binding, expiry filtering, and permission decisions remain with code-behind and the data service.

entries.name: Events.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: DataList binding and edit navigation are preserved while only the themed event-item markup is rebuilt.

localizedText.zh-CN: 保留 DataList 绑定和编辑入口，只重构每条事件的主题化展示结构。
localizedText.en: DataList binding and edit navigation are preserved while only the themed event-item markup is rebuilt.

entries.name: Events.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: The event list disables ViewState and renders events returned for the current module; title, time/place, and summary use encoded binding so content is not emitted as markup.

localizedText.zh-CN: 事件列表关闭 ViewState 并展示数据服务返回的当前模块事件；标题、时间地点和摘要使用编码绑定，避免把正文当作标记输出。
localizedText.en: The event list disables ViewState and renders events returned for the current module; title, time/place, and summary use encoded binding so content is not emitted as markup.

entries.name: Events.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: Each edit link is visible only when IsEditable is true and keeps the current ItemID; button visibility does not grant client-side write authorization.

localizedText.zh-CN: 每条编辑链接仅在 IsEditable 为真时可见，并沿用当前 ItemID；按钮可见不代表客户端获得写入授权。
localizedText.en: Each edit link is visible only when IsEditable is true and keeps the current ItemID; button visibility does not grant client-side write authorization.

entries.name: HtmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The shared module-title control hosts the edit entry and themed title; whether the action is rendered remains a server-side permission decision.

localizedText.zh-CN: 共享模块标题控件负责承载编辑入口和主题化标题；其是否输出动作仍由服务器权限上下文决定。
localizedText.en: The shared module-title control hosts the edit entry and themed title; whether the action is rendered remains a server-side permission decision.

entries.name: HtmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The edit address points only to the existing HTML editor; the markup does not route general-user input or external resources into the trusted-HTML rendering path.

localizedText.zh-CN: 编辑地址只连接到既有 HTML 编辑页，标记层不把普通用户输入或外部资源接入受信任 HTML 渲染路径。
localizedText.en: The edit address points only to the existing HTML editor; the markup does not route general-user input or external resources into the trusted-HTML rendering path.

entries.name: HtmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: Raw HTML is still injected by code-behind under the trusted-admin boundary; this markup only supplies the themed display container.

localizedText.zh-CN: 原始 HTML 仍由 code-behind 按受信任管理员边界注入，这里只提供主题化展示容器。
localizedText.en: Raw HTML is still injected by code-behind under the trusted-admin boundary; this markup only supplies the themed display container.

entries.name: HtmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: HtmlHolder is only the server container for trusted code-behind content; without a valid record it stays empty and does not disclose raw configuration values to the client.

localizedText.zh-CN: HtmlHolder 只是 code-behind 注入受信任内容的服务器容器；没有有效记录时保持空容器，不向客户端泄露原始配置值。
localizedText.en: HtmlHolder is only the server container for trusted code-behind content; without a valid record it stays empty and does not disclose raw configuration values to the client.

entries.name: ImageModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The shared module-title control hosts the image-edit entry under server permission control; the markup does not grant edit capability by itself.

localizedText.zh-CN: 共享模块标题控件承载受服务器权限控制的图片编辑入口；标记层不自行授予编辑能力。
localizedText.en: The shared module-title control hosts the image-edit entry under server permission control; the markup does not grant edit capability by itself.

entries.name: ImageModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The media container hosts only image output normalized by the navigation policy; code-behind hides invalid addresses instead of echoing raw settings.

localizedText.zh-CN: 媒体容器只承载经过导航策略归一化的图片输出；非法地址由 code-behind 隐藏图片，不回显原始设置。
localizedText.en: The media container hosts only image output normalized by the navigation policy; code-behind hides invalid addresses instead of echoing raw settings.

entries.name: ImageModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The server writes the image URL and optional dimensions from module settings; the markup does not process uploads, external-link allow lists, or binary resources.

localizedText.zh-CN: 图片地址和可选尺寸均由服务器从模块设置写入控件；标记层不处理上传、外链白名单或二进制资源。
localizedText.en: The server writes the image URL and optional dimensions from module settings; the markup does not process uploads, external-link allow lists, or binary resources.

entries.name: Links.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The shared module-title control hosts the link-edit entry and themed title; action visibility remains a server-side permission decision.

localizedText.zh-CN: 共享模块标题控件承载链接编辑入口和主题化标题；动作是否可见仍由服务器权限上下文决定。
localizedText.en: The shared module-title control hosts the link-edit entry and themed title; action visibility remains a server-side permission decision.

entries.name: Links.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The title control uses the in-site EditLinks page to repair legacy links; the markup does not contain save or authorization logic.

localizedText.zh-CN: 标题控件使用站内 EditLinks 页面作为修复旧链接的入口，标记层不直接承载保存或授权逻辑。
localizedText.en: The title control uses the in-site EditLinks page to repair legacy links; the markup does not contain save or authorization logic.

entries.name: Links.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: Standard links render as a themed link group; editing still routes through the existing EditLinks page.

localizedText.zh-CN: 普通链接以主题化链接组呈现；编辑入口仍走既有 EditLinks 页面。
localizedText.en: Standard links render as a themed link group; editing still routes through the existing EditLinks page.

entries.name: Links.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: The current module data service binds the link list; titles and descriptions follow display-output rules, and client items are not trusted as edit targets or URL sources.

localizedText.zh-CN: 链接列表由当前模块数据服务绑定；标题和说明按展示输出规则处理，客户端项不作为编辑目标或 URL 信任来源。
localizedText.en: The current module data service binds the link list; titles and descriptions follow display-output rules, and client items are not trusted as edit targets or URL sources.

entries.name: Links.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The edit address uses an in-site ItemID path only in the IsEditable context; browse URLs must pass navigation policy, with invalid legacy values falling back to encoded text.

localizedText.zh-CN: 编辑地址只在 IsEditable 上下文使用站内 ItemID 路径；浏览地址必须通过导航策略，非法旧值回退为编码文本。
localizedText.en: The edit address uses an in-site ItemID path only in the IsEditable context; browse URLs must pass navigation policy, with invalid legacy values falling back to encoded text.

entries.name: ModuleProbe.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: P3.2 is a read-only deployment-package verification sample; it writes no business data and exposes no script, upload, or external-link entry.

localizedText.zh-CN: P3.2 只读模块包验证样例：不写入业务数据，不提供脚本、上传或外链入口。
localizedText.en: P3.2 is a read-only deployment-package verification sample; it writes no business data and exposes no script, upload, or external-link entry.

entries.name: ModuleProbe.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The table only presents server-provided package, module, placement, theme-scope, and render-time diagnostics; these values are not client-editable configuration.

localizedText.zh-CN: 表格字段只呈现服务器提供的包、模块、放置、主题范围和渲染时间诊断值，不把它们当作客户端可修改配置。
localizedText.en: The table only presents server-provided package, module, placement, theme-scope, and render-time diagnostics; these values are not client-editable configuration.

entries.name: ModuleProbe.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: All labels are encoded read-only results; the probe page provides no callback, persistence, or navigation side effect.

localizedText.zh-CN: 所有 Label 均为编码后的只读结果，探针页面不提供回调、保存或导航副作用。
localizedText.en: All labels are encoded read-only results; the probe page provides no callback, persistence, or navigation side effect.

entries.name: QuickLinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The quick-links module renders as a compact link group while preserving the add entry and existing data binding.

localizedText.zh-CN: 快捷链接模块以紧凑链接组呈现，保留新增入口和原有数据绑定。
localizedText.en: The quick-links module renders as a compact link group while preserving the add entry and existing data binding.

entries.name: QuickLinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: P8.3 connects the quick-links local header to the shared module title/action contract without duplicating the outer module title.

localizedText.zh-CN: P8.3 让快捷链接自有头部接入统一模块标题/动作区契约，避免与外层模块标题重复。
localizedText.en: P8.3 connects the quick-links local header to the shared module title/action contract without duplicating the outer module title.

entries.name: QuickLinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The server decides action-area visibility from roles and module-edit context; hiding or showing a button does not replace backend authorization.

localizedText.zh-CN: 动作区是否可见由服务器角色和模块编辑上下文决定；隐藏或显示按钮都不替代后端授权检查。
localizedText.en: The server decides action-area visibility from roles and module-edit context; hiding or showing a button does not replace backend authorization.

entries.name: QuickLinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: The current module's data service binds the link list with ViewState disabled; titles use encoded binding, and addresses must pass the server navigation policy before becoming browse links.

localizedText.zh-CN: 链接列表由当前模块的数据服务绑定且关闭 ViewState；标题使用编码绑定，地址必须经过服务器导航策略后才能进入浏览链接。
localizedText.en: The current module's data service binds the link list with ViewState disabled; titles use encoded binding, and addresses must pass the server navigation policy before becoming browse links.

entries.name: QuickLinks.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The edit link gets an edit address only when the current module is editable; invalid or disallowed legacy addresses fall back to encoded text without external-navigation side effects.

localizedText.zh-CN: 编辑链接仅在当前模块可编辑时生成编辑地址；无效或不允许的旧地址回退为编码文本，不产生外部导航副作用。
localizedText.en: The edit link gets an edit address only when the current module is editable; invalid or disallowed legacy addresses fall back to encoded text without external-navigation side effects.

entries.name: Signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The sign-in control collects the login identifier, password, and remember-me option, then lets the code-behind forms-authentication flow validate credentials, issue tickets, or display failure messages.

localizedText.zh-CN: 登录控件负责采集登录标识、口令和记住登录选项，并通过 code-behind 的表单认证流程完成校验、票据写入和失败提示。
localizedText.en: The sign-in control collects the login identifier, password, and remember-me option, then lets the code-behind forms-authentication flow validate credentials, issue tickets, or display failure messages.

entries.name: Signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: P7.4 uses a real form layout and Button for sign-in instead of legacy image buttons.

localizedText.zh-CN: P7.4 登录区改为真实表单布局和 Button，不再使用旧图片按钮。
localizedText.en: P7.4 uses a real form layout and Button for sign-in instead of legacy image buttons.

entries.name: Signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The server control receives the login identifier and passes it to the existing authentication flow; the page does not decide account existence or authorization on the client.

localizedText.zh-CN: 登录标识由服务器控件接收并进入既有认证流程；页面不在客户端判断账号是否存在或具备权限。
localizedText.en: The server control receives the login identifier and passes it to the existing authentication flow; the page does not decide account existence or authorization on the client.

entries.name: Signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: The password input and hidden ciphertext field support pre-submit protection; the hidden field is still client-posted data, so final validation, failure handling, and ticket issuance must remain server-side.

localizedText.zh-CN: 密码输入和隐藏密文字段共同服务于提交前保护；隐藏字段仍是客户端回传值，最终校验、失败处理和票据签发必须由服务器完成。
localizedText.en: The password input and hidden ciphertext field support pre-submit protection; the hidden field is still client-posted data, so final validation, failure handling, and ticket issuance must remain server-side.

entries.name: Signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary:
This line states an existing fact only (the help module already says a forgotten password must be reset by a platform
    administrator); it carries no request parameter or dynamic content. The wording comes from a resource key with a Chinese
    and an English version, so it follows the interface language.
    Note: a resource expression is only allowed inside a **server control attribute** — in a text position ASP.NET raises
    HttpParseException — so an asp:Literal carries it here rather than writing <%$ %> into the markup.

localizedText.zh-CN:
这一行只陈述既有事实（帮助模块已写明"忘记密码请联系平台管理员重置"），不含任何请求参数或动态内容；
    文案由资源键提供，中英各一份，界面语言切换时随之切换。
    注意：资源表达式只能出现在**服务器控件属性**里（文本节点位置会被 ASP.NET 判为 HttpParseException），
    故这里用 asp:Literal 承载，而不是把 <%$ %> 直接写在文本里。
localizedText.en:
This line states an existing fact only (the help module already says a forgotten password must be reset by a platform
    administrator); it carries no request parameter or dynamic content. The wording comes from a resource key with a Chinese
    and an English version, so it follows the interface language.
    Note: a resource expression is only allowed inside a **server control attribute** — in a text position ASP.NET raises
    HttpParseException — so an asp:Literal carries it here rather than writing <%$ %> into the markup.

entries.name: Signin.ascx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.summary: The sign-in button enters LoginBtn_Click, while the registration link is shown only when the code-behind explicitly enables it; authentication results and redirects cannot be forged by the markup.

localizedText.zh-CN: 登录按钮进入 LoginBtn_Click，注册链接仅在 code-behind 明确开放时显示；认证结果和跳转不能由标记层伪造。
localizedText.en: The sign-in button enters LoginBtn_Click, while the registration link is shown only when the code-behind explicitly enables it; authentication results and redirects cannot be forged by the markup.

entries.name: ViewDocument.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The document-view endpoint disables themes and master-page wrapping to preserve the legacy Web Forms behavior where the code-behind writes the download response directly.

localizedText.zh-CN: 文档查看入口禁用主题和母版包装，保留 code-behind 直接写出下载响应的旧 Web Forms 行为。
localizedText.en: The document-view endpoint disables themes and master-page wrapping to preserve the legacy Web Forms behavior where the code-behind writes the download response directly.

entries.name: ViewDocument.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: This markup layer contains no server controls or business display region; document identity, authorization, path resolution, and response headers are handled at the code-behind boundary.

localizedText.zh-CN: 此标记层不包含服务器控件或业务展示区域；文件标识、权限、路径解析和响应头均由 code-behind 边界处理。
localizedText.en: This markup layer contains no server controls or business display region; document identity, authorization, path resolution, and response headers are handled at the code-behind boundary.

entries.name: XmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The shared module-title control hosts the XML-edit entry under server permission control; the markup does not grant edit capability by itself.

localizedText.zh-CN: 共享模块标题控件承载受服务器权限控制的 XML 编辑入口；标记层不自行授予编辑能力。
localizedText.en: The shared module-title control hosts the XML-edit entry under server permission control; the markup does not grant edit capability by itself.

entries.name: XmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: The XML container provides an output area only for in-application resources that pass trusted-deployment path checks; invalid configuration receives a neutral server-side notice.

localizedText.zh-CN: XML 容器只为已通过受信任部署路径校验的站内资源提供输出区域；无效配置由服务器给出中性提示。
localizedText.en: The XML container provides an output area only for in-application resources that pass trusted-deployment path checks; invalid configuration receives a neutral server-side notice.

entries.name: XmlModule.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: Code-behind sets DocumentSource and TransformSource only after path and file-existence checks; the markup accepts neither client paths nor remote resources.

localizedText.zh-CN: DocumentSource 和 TransformSource 由 code-behind 在路径和文件存在性验证后设置；标记层不接受客户端路径或远程资源。
localizedText.en: Code-behind sets DocumentSource and TransformSource only after path and file-existence checks; the markup accepts neither client paths nor remote resources.

entries.name: DesktopModuleTitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The module-title control displays each portal module title and, when an edit page is configured and the current user has edit permission, shows the module action entry.

localizedText.zh-CN: 模块标题控件负责显示门户模块标题，并在配置了编辑页且当前用户具备编辑权限时显示模块动作入口。
localizedText.en: The module-title control displays each portal module title and, when an edit page is configured and the current user has edit permission, shows the module action entry.

entries.name: DesktopModuleTitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: P8.3 splits module headers into title and action areas so modules can gradually share one semantic contract.

localizedText.zh-CN: P8.3 将模块标题正式拆为标题区和动作区，其他模块可逐步复用同一套语义契约。
localizedText.en: P8.3 splits module headers into title and action areas so modules can gradually share one semantic contract.

entries.name: DesktopModuleTitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The server control supplies the module title with its own ViewState disabled; the page only presents the current module context.

localizedText.zh-CN: 模块标题由服务器控件提供并关闭自身 ViewState，页面只呈现当前模块上下文。
localizedText.en: The server control supplies the module title with its own ViewState disabled; the page only presents the current module context.

entries.name: DesktopModuleTitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary: The server decides action-area visibility from edit-page configuration and current permission; client styling or markup cannot override it.

localizedText.zh-CN: 动作区是否可见由服务器根据编辑页配置和当前权限决定，不能由客户端样式或标记覆盖。
localizedText.en: The server decides action-area visibility from edit-page configuration and current permission; client styling or markup cannot override it.

entries.name: DesktopModuleTitle.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The edit link keeps the server-generated target and permission decision; without a valid edit page it must not be treated as usable navigation.

localizedText.zh-CN: 编辑链接沿用服务器生成的目标和权限判断；没有有效编辑页时不应把它当作可用导航。
localizedText.en: The edit link keeps the server-generated target and permission decision; without a valid edit page it must not be treated as usable navigation.

entries.name: DesktopPortalBanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: DesktopPortalBanner is the shared header control for desktop portal pages; the site name, user bar, and tab list all come from server-side portal configuration and identity context, while markup only renders the legacy Web Forms template.

localizedText.zh-CN: DesktopPortalBanner 是每个桌面门户页面共享的页眉控件；站点名称、用户栏和 Tab 列表均来自服务器端门户配置与身份上下文，标记层只负责按旧 Web Forms 模板输出。
localizedText.en: DesktopPortalBanner is the shared header control for desktop portal pages; the site name, user bar, and tab list all come from server-side portal configuration and identity context, while markup only renders the legacy Web Forms template.

entries.name: DesktopPortalBanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary:
The brand mark is a static asset shipped with the code (src/Portal/Images/portal-logo.png); it comes from no
    database and accepts no request parameter. Its alternative text names the project, while the brand text follows
    immediately, so the image carries no additional meaning.

localizedText.zh-CN:
品牌标识为随代码发布的静态资源（src/Portal/Images/portal-logo.png），不经数据库、不接受请求参数。
    替代文本给出项目标识；品牌文字紧随其后，故该图不承担额外语义。
localizedText.en:
The brand mark is a static asset shipped with the code (src/Portal/Images/portal-logo.png); it comes from no
    database and accepts no request parameter. Its alternative text names the project, while the brand text follows
    immediately, so the image carries no additional meaning.

entries.name: DesktopPortalBanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The server context generates the welcome text, logoff link, and portal entries in the user bar; the page does not infer identity or session state on its own.

localizedText.zh-CN: 用户栏中的欢迎文本、注销链接和门户入口由服务器上下文生成；页面不自行推断当前身份或会话状态。
localizedText.en: The server context generates the welcome text, logoff link, and portal entries in the user bar; the page does not infer identity or session state on its own.

entries.name: DesktopPortalBanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 4
entries.summary:
The former "Documentation" button pointed at `/admin/NotImplemented.aspx` — a not-implemented placeholder —
  a dead link inside the public chrome, now removed. A documentation entry should be re-added only once the
  deployment supplies a real documentation address, so that no "not implemented" page is ever exposed to users.

localizedText.zh-CN:
原「门户文档」按钮指向 `/admin/NotImplemented.aspx`（未实现占位页），是公开导航里的一处死链，
  已移除。文档入口应由部署侧提供真实文档地址后再挂回，避免把"未实现"页面暴露给使用者。
localizedText.en:
The former "Documentation" button pointed at `/admin/NotImplemented.aspx` — a not-implemented placeholder —
  a dead link inside the public chrome, now removed. A documentation entry should be re-added only once the
  deployment supplies a real documentation address, so that no "not implemented" page is ever exposed to users.

entries.name: DesktopPortalBanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 5
entries.summary: The Tabs data source comes from portal configuration; each navigation URL combines the application path, index, and TabId, while visibility and access remain server-controlled.

localizedText.zh-CN: Tabs 数据源来自门户配置；每个导航 URL 由应用路径、索引和 TabId 组合，实际可见性与访问权限仍由服务器控制。
localizedText.en: The Tabs data source comes from portal configuration; each navigation URL combines the application path, index, and TabId, while visibility and access remain server-controlled.

entries.name: DesktopPortalBanner.ascx webforms-server-comment 6
entries.summary:
A regular tab item renders the server-bound name and URL; the template presents navigation and does not treat bound values as client-side authorization decisions. The URL is now produced by a code-behind method because a <%= %> code block is not allowed inside a server-control attribute in Web Forms. Each item also emits a hidden disabled element that the tab gate can reveal for administrators together with the blocked reason; because it defaults to hidden it emits no HTML at all while the gate is off.
    The name likewise goes through a code-behind method (`BuildTabDisplayName`): tab names now support Chinese / English / other-languages columns, so binding the Chinese column directly would produce reverse mixing in English UIs.

localizedText.zh-CN:
普通 Tab 项输出服务器绑定的名称与 URL；模板只呈现导航，不把绑定值当作客户端权限判断。URL 改由 code-behind 方法生成，避免在服务器控件属性中使用 <%= %> 代码块（Web Forms 不允许）。每项同时输出一个默认隐藏的禁用态元素，供 Tab 门控在管理员可见时替换显示并携带阻断原因；默认隐藏使其在门控关闭时完全不输出 HTML。
    名称同样走 code-behind 方法（`BuildTabDisplayName`）：页签名已支持中/英/其它语言三列，直接绑定中文列会让英文界面出现反向混排。
localizedText.en:
A regular tab item renders the server-bound name and URL; the template presents navigation and does not treat bound values as client-side authorization decisions. The URL is now produced by a code-behind method because a <%= %> code block is not allowed inside a server-control attribute in Web Forms. Each item also emits a hidden disabled element that the tab gate can reveal for administrators together with the blocked reason; because it defaults to hidden it emits no HTML at all while the gate is off.
    The name likewise goes through a code-behind method (`BuildTabDisplayName`): tab names now support Chinese / English / other-languages columns, so binding the Chinese column directly would produce reverse mixing in English UIs.

entries.name: GenericErrorPage.aspx webforms-server-comment 1
entries.summary: The generic error page is the exception-convergence endpoint; it only displays a low-sensitivity event identifier so stack traces, paths, or request details are not sent to the client.

localizedText.zh-CN: 通用错误页是异常收敛出口；页面只显示低敏事件编号，避免把堆栈、路径或请求细节输出给客户端。
localizedText.en: The generic error page is the exception-convergence endpoint; it only displays a low-sensitivity event identifier so stack traces, paths, or request details are not sent to the client.

entries.name: GenericErrorPage.aspx webforms-server-comment 2
entries.summary: This page does not use the master page, ensuring the error path can still render a minimal HTML response when theme, navigation, or module initialization fails.

localizedText.zh-CN: 此页不使用母版页，确保错误路径在主题、导航或模块初始化失败时仍能渲染一份最小 HTML 响应。
localizedText.en: This page does not use the master page, ensuring the error path can still render a minimal HTML response when theme, navigation, or module initialization fails.

entries.name: GenericErrorPage.aspx webforms-server-comment 3
entries.summary: The panel text is now resource-driven: it previously used entity-encoded hard-coded Chinese, which made the error page display Chinese even in the English UI and conflicted with the localization goal. Entity encoding is no longer needed because the copy now lives in a UTF-8 resource file with an encoding declaration. The event id still comes from a server-side expression, and visual styling stays minimal and inline to avoid depending on external theme assets.

localizedText.zh-CN: 面板文本改为资源驱动：原先使用实体编码的硬编码中文，导致英文界面下错误页仍显示中文（与本地化目标冲突）。实体编码不再必要，因为文案已移入 UTF-8 且带编码声明的资源文件。事件编号仍由服务端表达式输出；视觉样式保持内联最小化，避免依赖外部主题资产。
localizedText.en: The panel text is now resource-driven: it previously used entity-encoded hard-coded Chinese, which made the error page display Chinese even in the English UI and conflicted with the localization goal. Entity encoding is no longer needed because the copy now lives in a UTF-8 resource file with an encoding declaration. The event id still comes from a server-side expression, and visual styling stays minimal and inline to avoid depending on external theme assets.
